jobs.description:
Please use Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox when accessing Candidate Home.

By joining the American Red Cross you will touch millions of lives every year and experience the greatness of the human spirit at its best. Are you ready to be part of the world's largest humanitarian network?

Join us—Where your Career is a Force for Good!

Job Description

Joining The American Red Cross is like nothing else – it’s as much something you feel as something you do. You become a vital part of the world’s largest humanitarian network. Joining a team of welcoming individuals who are exceptional, yet unassuming. Diverse, yet uncompromising in unity. You grow your career within a movement that matters, where success is measured in people helped, communities made whole, and individuals equipped to never stop changing lives and situations for the better.

When you choose to be a force for good, you’ll have mentors who empower your growth along a purposeful career path. You align your life’s work with an ongoing mission that’s bigger than all of us. As you care for others, you’re cared for with competitive compensation and benefits. You join a community that respects who you are away from work as much as what you do while at work.

Where Your Career is a Force for Good!

Summary

As a Marketing Associate, you’ll support the execution and evolution of our donor loyalty and marketing code programs across digital and onsite touchpoints. Working closely with the Sr. Marketing Manager, you'll help bring campaigns, content, and donor experiences to market while coordinating with a range of cross-functional partners. You'll play a key role in ensuring messaging and visuals are clear, consistent, and effective across channels. Success in this role comes from combining creativity, organization, and attention to detail to continuously enhance the donor experience.

Our Ideal Candidate

You’ve built a strong foundation of marketing experience and know how to turn strategy into creative work that captures attention and inspires action. You’re a strong, marketing-focused copywriter who can make complex information clear and engaging, and you bring thoughtful design direction that helps shape how ideas come to life. Consistency matters to you, so when the email, the poster, and the website say three slightly different things, you spot it and straighten it out. These strengths are central to your day-to-day work. You have opinions about clarity, too: a paragraph where a sentence would do, a call to action nobody understands, or an email that buries the point. You’re steady with details, good at closing loops, and while loyalty experience is a plus, curiosity about why donors come back counts for more.

Responsibilities

What You Will Do:



Develop and manage the creative assets, content, and messaging for the loyalty and digital marketing codes programs, keeping the donor experience accurate and consistent across channels.Shape how program strategies come to life by writing clear, engaging marketing copy and guiding the creative development of donor-facing materials.Support the planning and execution of campaigns, promotions and go-to-market strategies from concept through launch, working with creative, targeted marketing, operations, and IT partners.Manage and enhance loyalty experiences in the Blood Donor App and on the website, including messaging, dashboards, widgets, marketing codes and other engagement features.Develop the program materials donors see at donation centers and blood drives, coordinating with the project managers who own the overall onsite experience.Create program communications and maintain the asset libraries, resources, and updates that program managers, field teams and internal partners rely on.Collaborate with customer care and social care teams to answer questions, gather donor feedback and identify opportunities to improve the donor experience.Monitor campaign performance, donor behavior and key program metrics; prepare reports and apply insights to improve future initiatives.

Qualifications

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED:

4-year college degree or equivalent combination of education and experience, Business, Communications, Marketing or related fieldMinimum 5-7 years related experience required. Prior direct marketing experience strongly desired, especially in campaign development, creative asset management and digital experience.Highly developed oral and written communication skills.Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.Ability to assimilate information quickly, analyze problems, and implement solutions required.Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications required.Travel may be required.

The salary range for position is $75,000.00 - $80,000.00 / annually.

Note that American Red Cross salaries are aligned to the specific geographic location in which the work is primarily performed. Other factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills, how many years of experience you have and comparison to other employees already in this role.

Benefits For You

As a mission-based organization, we believe our team needs great support to do great work. Our comprehensive package includes:

Medical, Dental Vision plansHealth Spending Accounts & Flexible Spending AccountsPTO: Starting at 15 days a year; based on type of job and tenureHolidays: 11 paid holidays comprised of six core holidays and five floating holidays401K with up to 6% matchPaid Family LeaveEmployee AssistanceDisability and Insurance: Short + Long TermService Awards and recognition

Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Digital Marketing

Job Sub Function

Digital Marketing Strategy

Job Category

Professional

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of Orthopaedics? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our Orthopaedics teams help keep more than 6 million people moving each year while delivering clinical and economic value to surgeons and healthcare systems. Our teams build solutions for joint reconstruction; trauma and craniomaxillofacial; sports, extremities, and elective foot and ankle; spine; and robotics and digital surgery.

Guide prioritization of campaign investments and resources.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox
Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.


We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.


The Opportunity
This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.


You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.


You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.


What You'll Own
Client Strategy & Relationships


Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities
Paid Media Performance


Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables
Copy & Creative Strategy


Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment
Tracking & Funnel Execution


Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems


Requirements


5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Preferred Experience


Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising


NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+) Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.


How You Work
You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.


You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.



Benefits


Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus
Qualifications
5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-sol

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The Business Marketing Group connects businesses with their customers on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger to help them grow their businesses through solutions like pages, advertising, messaging, and more. We succeed when we help our customers grow their business leveraging our solutions. The Global Marketing Operations team runs campaign execution for business marketing, launching hundreds of campaigns a year across an expanding set of digital marketing channels.We are seeking a Marketing Operations Manager who executes campaigns AI-first, pairing deep expertise in marketing execution platforms with the AI skills to automate that work. This role is about owning operational quality by setting executional standards that can be built at agent scale. The ideal candidate is a digital marketing expert who has already replaced meaningful parts of their own workflow with AI and can show what it produced.





Marketing Operations Manager Responsibilities:


Own campaign execution and execution quality for an assigned business area, from brief through launch, across lifecycle, email, in-product messaging, web, and Meta ads
Use AI as the primary tool for execution work, including build specification, copy and asset variants, audience logic, and QA
Build, configure, and test AI agents that execute campaign workflows, and own the automation roadmap for the area, reporting results in turnaround time, cost, and error rate
Pilot new delivery capabilities, then codify what correct execution looks like and the eval rubrics that hold agents to it
Advise partners at the brief stage on what is executable and at what cost, and translate execution learnings into platform requirements
Raise the AI capability of the team through documentation, enablement, and coaching
Find new ways to continually streamline execution processes, including working with XFNs (if needed) to automate handoff





Minimum Qualifications:


6+ years of experience in marketing operations, campaign management, or marketing automation
Hands-on build experience in at least two digital marketing channels among email, paid social, in-product messaging, web, and SEM or display, with expert-level depth in at least one execution or ads platform (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, HubSpot, Adobe)
Demonstrated use of AI to produce real marketing work output, with specific examples of what was automated and the measured effect on time, cost, quality, or volume
Hands-on experience building, configuring, and evaluating AI agents or LLM-based workflows, including prompt iteration and judgment on where output requires human review
Experience owning campaign execution at portfolio scale, including QA and trade-off decisions across competing requests
Experience scaling impact beyond own execution, through standards others adopted, requirements platform teams built, and enablement that raised team capability
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience in digital marketing





Preferred Qualifications:


Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
Experience supporting B2B marketing efforts or high-volume audience segments at global scale
Experience leading the transition of a workflow from manual execution to automated or agentic execution
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
Experience connecting AI tools to marketing systems through APIs, integrations, or agent tooling
SQL fluency or comparable data skills, sufficient to validate audiences and interrogate campaign performance independently
Comfort working in ambiguity, where the standard does not exist yet and part of the job is writing it
Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)





About Meta:


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.





Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.




Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.

UPS Digital Product Marketing Manager

Company Overview

UPS is a Fortune Global 500 organization focused on delivering innovative solutions and creating value for customers. The Secure Commerce portfolio includes InsureShield and Parcel Pro Secure Commerce solutions. As a Product Marketing Manager, Secure Commerce, you will connect product capabilities with customer needs, market opportunities, and business growth objectives. You will collaborate with Product Management, Sales, Strategic Partnerships, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Operations to develop commercialization strategies that increase customer adoption, market penetration, and revenue growth.

Role and Responsibilities of UPS Digital Product Marketing Manager

You will develop and execute commercialization strategies for the Secure Commerce portfolio. You will define target market segments, ideal customer profiles, buyer personas, value propositions, competitive positioning, and go-to-market plans.

Experience in regulated industries, logistics, commerce, or multi-channel platform environments.Familiarity with modern marketing technology (MarTech) and ABM tools.Experience partnering with analytics or data teams to measure marketing impact.Comfort working in lean, fast-moving marketing organizations.Experience using automation and AI-assisted workflows to scale marketing impact.Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to align Product, Sales, Channel, and Marketing teams around shared outcomes.Compensation and Benefits of UPS Digital Product Marketing Manager

Ready Set Rocket (A Sia Company), partners with ambitious brands to solve complex business challenges through integrated marketing, digital experience, customer strategy, creative, media, data and technology. We are building on significant momentum and investing in the next stage of our growth. Our clients look to us for strategic partnership that connects business objectives with measurable outcomes across the full customer journey.

Job Description

Sia Title: Independent Contractor (1099)

Project Title: Senior Social Media Strategy Lead (Freelance Contract)

Project Length: October 5th- November 30th 2026 with potential to extend if project needs evolve.

Project Hours: Approximately 10 hours/week, with flexibility to increase hours depending on project needs. Must be available for collaboration during business hours (9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET).

Fixed Fee Range: $5,000-$5,500 for the initial 5-week engagement. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, skills and agreed-upon scope and monthly deliverables rather than tracked hours. This is a fixed-fee project, not an hourly engagement.

You will be paid out monthly on a net 30 day schedule.

Scope of work

Build on the existing social strategy, refining the content approach with the client, creator strategist, and brand strategist as needed.Develop creative briefs for priority channels and work closely with the creative team as they build social content.Guide the creator strategy and related work through client review and approval.Review social creative, provide clear feedback, and guide final deliverables through client approval.Lead development of the community management playbook and oversee the community manager through the end of the project.Qualifications

jobs.description:
I'm hiring a Social Media & Content Manager to join my team 🎯

I'm looking for someone to take real ownership of my content and social strategy. Someone who is not just executing posts, but understanding my audience deeply and running the engine that turns content into growth. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to build something with me, not just manage a calendar.

What you'll own

Weekly reporting on total posts, total IG views, email/Manychat leads collected, and trials to my fitness app offering driven from social. You'll be close enough to the numbers to know what's actually moving the needle and help iterate from there.

Phase 1 — Get to know my audience

You'll dig into my DMs, community messages, in-app chat, and survey responses to build a real picture of who my audience is: their desired outcome, their biggest issues, and their limiting beliefs. From there, you'll define my content pillars and build out a swipe file of viral, high-performing content across those pillars to draw inspiration from (likely living in Notion).
Phase 2 — Run the content engine

Using a 70/20/10 approach, you'll manage my content pipeline: 70% doubling down on what's already working, 20% smart variations you develop, and 10% brand-new ideas you pitch and test (2–4 fresh concepts a week). You'll own my trial reels engine — 1–3 highly viral reels a day within my content pillars — handling post creation end to end, and reporting weekly on what worked, what didn't, and why.
Phase 3 — Grow beyond Instagram

Once Instagram is running like a well-oiled machine, we'll look at expanding to Facebook, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Pinterest, and figure out what team/support that would need.

What you need

Experience working in the social media creator space is a must — you should understand creator content, platform trends, and what makes short-form video perform. Experience in fitness is a plus! Beyond that, you should be comfortable going deep on research and audience psychology, then turning that into content that performs. I'm looking for someone who thrives on researching, testing, and iterating and has a passion for content creation!

jobs.title: Strategic Events Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role:

We are looking for an energetic, highly organized, A-player who loves a fast-paced, high-performing environment. Working within Marketing, this role will support the production for Samsara's annual customer conference, Beyond, our global Go Beyond programs, and other hosted events throughout the year.
This role supports end-to-end production planning for Samsara's keynotes, breakouts, expo hall and general sessions, covering run-of-show creation, AV planning, rehearsal scheduling, and speaker management, all while executing alongside our production vendor onsite.
You'll manage relationships with production vendors and internal stakeholders while overseeing the workstreams and details that turn a production plan into a flawless live experience. Partnering closely with other members of the marketing, product, sales engineers, and customer success teams, you'll help shape programming and engagement that ladder up to Samsara's business objectives, driving best-in-class events.
This is a remote role open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. This role requires travel, candidates must be open to traveling 30% of the time. 

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world:
Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career:
If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity:
The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best:
At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You
will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. 

In this role, you will:

Coordinate keynote and breakout planning and execution across key internal stakeholders, Samsara’s main production vendor and venue partners.
Support content production by building timelines, scheduling rehearsals, sourcing vehicles and equipment, and managing exec schedules and internal/external speakers.
Review venue contracts to ensure production needs are being met.
Assist in managing expo production needs including coordinating details between internal stakeholders, vendors, and the venue.
Oversee multiple events and programs with overlapping schedules.
Bring energy, creativity, and new ideas to build a successful event experience.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

3+ years of experience in event management/production
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is required.
This role requires travel, candidates must be open to traveling 30% of the time. 
Experience using AI tools to work more efficiently.

An ideal candidate also has:

Strong communication, negotiation, and budget-management skills, with the ability to work across all levels of an organization.
Proven ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, navigate shifting priorities, and consistently deliver against deadlines without compromising execution quality.
Excellent project management and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to build scalable processes, documentation, timelines, and operational frameworks.
Ability to work independently in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.
Annual Base Salary: $79,135 USD - $119,700 USD
Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Production Manager (Websites & SEO)
jobs.description:
Production Manager (Websites & SEO) Company:
Contractor Growth Network (CGN)
Location:
Charlotte, NC (Hybrid)
Employment Type:
Full-Time
Compensation:
$75,000–$90,000 annually + performance pay
Reports To:
Vice President / Integrator

About CGN CGN is a marketing agency specializing in website design, development, and SEO for remodeling and design-build companies. We help contractors attract the right customers and grow through effective digital marketing.
Our core values are One Size Fits One, Seek Excellence, Nail the Details, Be Your Best You, Love Your Impact, and Proactive Leadership.

About the Role We're hiring a Production Manager
to own the day-to-day execution of website projects and recurring SEO deliverables. You'll establish internal schedules, assign and prioritize work, manage team capacity, lead daily production check-ins, oversee quality standards, and ensure commitments are met.

This is an internal production leadership role, not a hands-on designer, developer, or SEO specialist position
. You'll need strong website production knowledge and the confidence to direct specialists, address missed deadlines, and resolve bottlenecks.

You'll have authority over internal assignments, deadlines, and priorities, but no direct reports. You'll document recurring performance concerns and escalate formal personnel matters to leadership. Account Managers own all client communication; you own internal production execution.

Your job is to ensure the right work gets completed correctly and on time, without constant leadership intervention.

Key ResponsibilitiesWebsite Production Create and own internal schedules, assignments, priorities, and deadlines for active website projects.
Understand website discovery, copywriting, design, development, QA, and launch dependencies to sequence work appropriately.
Assign work across designers, developers, writers, and other specialists based on capacity and deadlines.
Monitor progress daily; identify stalled tasks, bottlenecks, and delivery risks before deadlines are missed.
Coordinate internal handoffs and communicate timeline changes to Account Managers and leadership.
Keep website production plans, ownership, and task statuses accurate in Monday.com.

SEO Production Own production operations for recurring monthly SEO deliverables, including scheduling, prioritization, workflow, and delivery consistency.
Work with SEO specialists to turn their strategies and planned deliverables into clear assignments and deadlines.
Coordinate content, optimization, technical SEO, and related tasks across specialists, writers, and developers.
Track completed, outstanding, and at-risk work for each SEO client; address delays before monthly commitments are missed.
Ensure established QA procedures are followed and recurring delivery problems are identified.

SEO specialists own strategy and technical execution. The Production Manager owns operational follow-through and timely delivery.

Daily Leadership & Accountability Lead daily production check-ins to clarify priorities, progress, blockers, and next steps.
Set clear expectations for task ownership, deadlines, and completion standards.
Follow up consistently, address missed commitments directly, and prevent overdue work from accumulating.
Rebalance assignments with specialists when workloads are unrealistic; communicate resulting timeline impacts.
Independently reprioritize production work to meet business commitments.
Document repeated missed deadlines or performance concerns and report them to leadership.

Quality & Workflow Oversight Ensure specialists complete technical QA and work meets established requirements before being marked complete.
Spot-check deliverables for completeness, accuracy, and adherence to production standards.
Return substandard work to the responsible specialist with clear corrections and a revised deadline.
Track recurring quality problems and recommend improvements to reduce rework.
Identify inefficient handoffs, scheduling problems, and production bottlenecks; recommend practical process improvements.

Monday.com, Reporting & Collaboration Use Monday.com
to actively manage assignments, deadlines, dependencies, workload, and project status.
Maintain live visibility into overdue work, upcoming milestones, and production capacity.
Prepare weekly production scorecards and risk updates for the Vice President / Integrator.
Coordinate regularly with Account Managers so they can accurately manage client expectations.
Communicate production risks proactively and escalate issues requiring leadership decisions.
Maintain clear internal documentation and reinforce accurate task updates across the team.

Division of Responsibility Production Manager:
Internal schedules, assignments, priorities, workload balancing, production accountability, SEO delivery tracking, quality oversight, and reporting.
Account Managers:
Client relationships, communication, expectations, information collection, feedback, and approvals.
Production Specialists:
Technical execution, specialist-level QA, technical recommendations, and SEO strategy where applicable.

QualificationsRequired Demonstrated experience managing production workflows, digital projects, or delivery operations; proven ownership matters more than a specific number of years
.
Strong understanding of website development phases, dependencies, QA, and launch processes.
Direct Monday.com experience
managing projects, tasks, and deadlines.
Proven ability to establish schedules, assign work, prioritize competing demands, and enforce deadlines.
Experience coordinating multiple concurrent projects or recurring deliverables.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, follow-through, and independent judgment.
Confidence leading production meetings, addressing missed commitments, and holding contributors accountable.
Ability to identify capacity constraints, production risks, and quality concerns early.
Clear written and verbal communication and effective collaboration with technical and client-facing teams.
Ability to work in Charlotte, NC, under CGN's hybrid schedule.

Preferred Experience in a digital marketing, creative, or website development agency.
Familiarity with SEO workflows, content production, and recurring monthly deliverables.
Experience coordinating designers, developers, copywriters, and SEO specialists.
Experience building production dashboards, scorecards, or process improvements.
Familiarity with CMS platforms, website QA, UX, and SEO fundamentals.

What Success Looks Like On-Time Delivery:
Website production milestones and monthly SEO deliverables are completed on schedule. Overdue work is actively resolved and risks are flagged early.
Quality:
Deliverables meet requirements, specialist QA is completed, and corrections are tracked through resolution.
Workload Management:
Team members have clear assignments and deadlines; priorities and capacity are adjusted proactively.
Production Visibility:
Monday.com reflects accurate progress, and weekly reporting gives leadership reliable insight into delivery performance.
Specific targets will be established using CGN's production standards and commitments.

The Right Person for This Role You take ownership without waiting for direction. You're organized, decisive, and comfortable setting expectations and having direct conversations when commitments are missed. You understand how creative and technical work moves through production, spot risks early, and use accurate data to make decisions. You care about quality, communicate proactively, and follow through until work is complete.
This role isn't a fit for someone who only monitors task lists, avoids accountability conversations, or waits until deadlines have passed to intervene.

Why You Should Join Our Team Paid Time Off:
36 paid days annually, including 25 PTO days and 11 paid federal holidays.
401(k):
Company match of up to 4%.
Benefits:
CGN covers 50% of health and dental insurance premiums and 100% of life insurance. Vision insurance and parental leave are also offered.
Professional Development:
Industry certifications, training, and ongoing learning opportunities.
Clients:
Work with quality-driven, high-end interior remodeling contractors who value long-term partnerships.

Schedule Hours:
Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM.
Location:
Charlotte, NC.
Hybrid:
First 90 days fully in-office; afterward, three days in-office and two remote days weekly.

How Our Hiring Process Works 15-Minute Phone Interview
Preliminary Zoom Interview
Strengths Assessment and Culture-Fit Interview
Practical Interview
Reference and Background Check

jobs.title: Strategic Events Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role:

We are looking for an energetic, highly organized, A-player who loves a fast-paced, high-performing environment. Working within Marketing, this role will support the production for Samsara's annual customer conference, Beyond, our global Go Beyond programs, and other hosted events throughout the year.
This role supports end-to-end production planning for Samsara's keynotes, breakouts, expo hall and general sessions, covering run-of-show creation, AV planning, rehearsal scheduling, and speaker management, all while executing alongside our production vendor onsite.
You'll manage relationships with production vendors and internal stakeholders while overseeing the workstreams and details that turn a production plan into a flawless live experience. Partnering closely with other members of the marketing, product, sales engineers, and customer success teams, you'll help shape programming and engagement that ladder up to Samsara's business objectives, driving best-in-class events.
This is a remote role open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. This role requires travel, candidates must be open to traveling 30% of the time. 

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world:
Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career:
If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity:
The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best:
At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You
will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. 

In this role, you will:

Coordinate keynote and breakout planning and execution across key internal stakeholders, Samsara’s main production vendor and venue partners.
Support content production by building timelines, scheduling rehearsals, sourcing vehicles and equipment, and managing exec schedules and internal/external speakers.
Review venue contracts to ensure production needs are being met.
Assist in managing expo production needs including coordinating details between internal stakeholders, vendors, and the venue.
Oversee multiple events and programs with overlapping schedules.
Bring energy, creativity, and new ideas to build a successful event experience.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

3+ years of experience in event management/production
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is required.
This role requires travel, candidates must be open to traveling 30% of the time. 
Experience using AI tools to work more efficiently.

An ideal candidate also has:

Strong communication, negotiation, and budget-management skills, with the ability to work across all levels of an organization.
Proven ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, navigate shifting priorities, and consistently deliver against deadlines without compromising execution quality.
Excellent project management and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to build scalable processes, documentation, timelines, and operational frameworks.
Ability to work independently in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.
Annual Base Salary: $79,135 USD - $119,700 USD
Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.description:
**\*\*About the Role**
----------------------

\*\*

Rack Industries is seeking an experienced, results-driven

\*\*Digital Marketing Manager

\*\* to oversee and execute our digital marketing efforts. This individual will be responsible for managing paid advertising campaigns, email marketing, lead generation, and performance reporting.

We are looking for someone who is highly analytical, organized, and capable of independently managing multiple marketing channels while continuously identifying opportunities to increase leads, improve conversion rates, and maximize return on investment. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Google Ads, Google Local Services Ads (GLSA), Meta advertising, email marketing automation, and marketing analytics.

**\*\*Key Responsibilities**
----------------------------

\*\*

### **\*\*1. Paid Media Management**

\*\*

* Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns, including Search, Display, and remarketing.
* Oversee Google Local Services Ads (GLSA), including lead monitoring, budget management, and optimization.
* Develop, launch, and optimize Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns through Meta Ads Manager.
* Manage advertising budgets across all paid channels to maximize lead volume and return on ad spend.
* Conduct ongoing A/B testing of ad creatives, messaging, audiences, and landing pages.
* Monitor cost per lead, cost per acquisition, conversion rates, and overall campaign profitability.

### **\*\*2. Email Marketing & Automation**

\*\*

* Develop and execute email marketing campaigns focused on customer retention, reactivation, and lead nurturing.
* Build and manage automated email and SMS workflows.
* Segment customer databases to deliver targeted messaging.
* Develop campaigns that encourage repeat business, service appointments, and cross-selling opportunities.
* Monitor email performance, including open rates, click-through rates, conversions, and attributed revenue.
* Continuously optimize automation workflows to improve customer engagement and retention.

### **\*\*3. Lead Generation & Tracking**

\*\*

* Oversee lead generation across Google, Meta, and other digital marketing channels.
* Ensure accurate lead tracking, attribution, and reporting across advertising platforms and CRM systems.
* Monitor lead quality and work with the sales team to improve conversion rates.
* Identify opportunities to increase qualified leads while reducing acquisition costs.
* Troubleshoot tracking issues involving Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, conversion pixels, and CRM integrations.

### **\*\*4. Marketing Reporting & Analytics**

\*\*

* Create and maintain weekly and monthly marketing performance reports.
* Develop dashboards that provide visibility into advertising spend, lead generation, sales performance, and ROI.
* Track key performance indicators, including:

  + Cost Per Lead (CPL)
  + Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
  + Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
  + Lead-to-Customer Conversion Rate
  + Revenue Generated by Marketing Channel
  + Email Marketing & Automation Revenue
* Analyze campaign performance and present actionable recommendations to leadership.
* Ensure marketing data is accurate and consistent across reporting platforms.

### **\*\*5. Marketing Strategy & Optimization**

\*\*

* Develop and execute digital marketing strategies aligned with company revenue and growth goals.
* Identify opportunities to expand lead generation and improve customer retention.
* Collaborate with internal departments to align marketing campaigns with operational capacity and sales goals.
* Manage campaign calendars, promotional initiatives, and advertising launches.
* Continuously evaluate campaign performance and implement improvements.

**\*\*Qualifications**
----------------------

\*\*

\*\*Required:

\*\*

* 3+ years of experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, or paid media management.
* Proven experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.
* Experience with Google Local Services Ads (GLSA).
* Strong understanding of lead generation, conversion tracking, and marketing attribution.
* Experience building and managing email marketing campaigns and automated workflows.
* Proficiency in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, and advertising platform reporting.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret marketing data and make strategic decisions.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and time management skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of marketing performance.

\*\*Preferred:

\*\*

* Experience marketing for home service businesses, HVAC, electrical, or related service industries.
* Experience with ServiceTitan or similar CRM platforms.
* Familiarity with customer retention marketing and SMS automation.
* Experience managing significant monthly advertising budgets.
* Experience building marketing dashboards and automated reports.

**\*\*What We're Looking For**
------------------------------

\*\*

We want someone who can do more than simply manage advertising accounts. We are looking for a digital marketer who understands how marketing impacts actual business revenue.

The right candidate will take ownership of our marketing channels, proactively identify growth opportunities, maintain accurate reporting, and consistently work toward generating more qualified leads and revenue for Rack Electric.

\*\*Success in this role will be measured by lead generation, advertising efficiency, customer acquisition, retention performance, and overall marketing-driven revenue growth.

\*\*

M3 has offices in Japan, UK, France, Germany, Brazil, Sweden, China, USA, and South Korea, as well as India.

You will work closely with sales and marketing leadership across multiple business units to develop buyer personas, build outreach campaigns using email, LinkedIn, and sales engagement platforms, and continuously optimize performance to drive measurable pipeline growth.

jobs.title: Social Media and Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About The Wells Michael Collective

The Wells Michael Collective is an independent luxury real estate brokerage in Ladue, Missouri, led by partners Justin Michael and Suzie Wells. We represent significant homes across St. Louis and present them through architecture, design and the lives lived inside them.

The role

You will be the creative voice of The Wells Michael Collective across every screen and every printed page. You will own our social presence from concept to camera to caption, build the content strategy behind it, and design the brochures, mailers and campaigns that put our homes and our people in front of the right audience.

You will sit at the table with both partners and shape how the brand looks and sounds as it grows. Your ideas will move from sketch to published within days, with no agency layers or committee approvals in between. This is an in office and in field position, split between our Ladue office and shoots, listings and events across St. Louis.

What you will own

**Social media production and publishing**

* Plan, shoot, edit and publish content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube
* Produce short form video, reels and stories for every listing, from Coming Soon through Sold
* Direct photographers and videographers on set so every shoot matches the brand
* Write captions with an editorial voice: precise, warm and free of real estate clichés
* Manage the posting calendar, community replies and direct messages

**Content strategy**

* Build and run a monthly content strategy tied to listings, market moments, advisors and the St. Louis lifestyle
* Track performance every month and turn the numbers into next month's plan
* Develop recurring series that give people a reason to follow us: home stories, architecture, neighborhoods, design
* Grow audience quality as well as audience size, with the goal of reaching the clients who buy and sell significant homes

**Brand design**

* Design listing collateral in Canva: brochures, feature sheets, postcards, mailers and presentation pieces
* Keep every asset on brand using our Canva Brand Kit, palette and typography
* Prepare print files with correct bleed and specs for our print partners
* Build InDesign layouts for longer editorial pieces as the brand expands

**Brand expansion**

* Launch new advisors with a polished public profile and content plan
* Support press, magazine ads, events and community partnerships
* Help build the visual playbook that will carry the brand into new markets

What you bring

**Required**

* 3+ years producing social content and design work for a brand, ideally in luxury, hospitality, fashion, design or real estate
* Advanced Canva skills, with a portfolio that proves it
* An eye for elevation: you know the difference between expensive and significant, and your work shows restraint
* Strong photo and video skills on a phone and in an editing app such as CapCut, Premiere Rush or Lightroom
* Clear, polished writing with a natural editorial voice
* Comfort with analytics on Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn
* Organized, self directed and able to run a calendar with many moving parts
* Based in St. Louis and able to be on site at shoots, events and the Ladue office

**A plus**

* Adobe InDesign, Photoshop or Illustrator
* Experience with print production and working with print vendors
* Experience directing photographers, videographers or stylists
* A following or portfolio built around architecture, interiors or St. Louis

Please include a portfolio. We hire on the strength of the work.

Growth path

This role is designed to grow into the head of marketing as the company grows. The path is tied to results, and you will review progress with both partners every quarter.

* **Marketing & Brand Content Manager.** Own social, content strategy and listing design. Build the systems and the calendar.
* **Senior Brand Manager.** Lead campaigns, press and partnerships. Manage freelance photographers, videographers and designers.
* **Director of Marketing & Brand.** Lead a marketing team, own the brand budget and guide the brand into new markets.

You will also receive an annual professional development budget for courses, conferences and creative tools, plus direct mentorship from two partners who have built a luxury brand from the ground up.

Compensation, bonus and benefits

* **Base salary:** based on experience and portfolio
* **Annual bonus:** tied to company growth milestones you helped drive
* **Paid time off:** PTO and major holidays, with a quiet week between Christmas and New Year's
* **Professional development:** an annual budget for courses, conferences and creative tools
* **Your tools (provided by the company):** a laptop, Canva Pro, Adobe Creative Cloud and the gear you need to shoot
* **Access:** a front row seat inside some of the most significant homes in St. Louis, and direct connection to the clients, designers, architects, builders and community leaders who shape them, with real networking opportunities through our events and partnerships

How to apply

Send your resume, a portfolio link and three pieces of work you are proudest of to team@wellsmichael.com. Tell us in a few sentences what you would change first about our Instagram. We read every application, and finalists will complete a short paid creative exercise.

Pay: From $50,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

**About the Role**

We are hiring an SEO Specialist to improve client search rankings, strengthen local visibility, and help websites attract relevant organic traffic. You'll review website performance, identify technical and content issues, manage local search listings, and use campaign data to guide ongoing improvements.

This role is suited to someone with at least two years of SEO experience who can work methodically, write clear recommendations, and understand that meaningful search improvements take time. You'll be expected to monitor campaigns consistently, respond promptly when problems arise, and report results accurately without making promises the data cannot support.

**What You'll Be Responsible For**

* Audit client websites to identify technical SEO issues, content gaps, indexing problems, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop practical optimisation plans based on website audits, keyword research, and client objectives.
* Manage local business listings, check profile accuracy, and monitor customer reviews.
* Research keywords and search intent to identify opportunities for new pages and existing content improvements.
* Prepare clear content briefs outlining page objectives, target keywords, search intent, and recommended content structure.
* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, local visibility, and other relevant SEO performance indicators.
* Use Google Search Console and appropriate SEO tools to investigate changes in performance and identify potential issues.
* Review page titles, meta descriptions, internal links, headings, and other on-page SEO elements.
* Track campaign progress and prepare reports explaining performance changes, completed work, and recommended next steps.
* Investigate ranking declines, traffic changes, indexing issues, and other problems that may affect campaign performance.
* Keep campaign records, audit findings, and performance data accurate and organised.
* Respond promptly to client and team enquiries, particularly when a campaign requires investigation or corrective action.
* Communicate progress, concerns, and realistic expectations clearly to the relevant stakeholders.

**What You'll Bring**

* **At least 2 years of professional experience in SEO.**
* Practical knowledge of technical SEO, on-page optimisation, and local SEO.
* Familiarity with Google Search Console and relevant SEO research, auditing, and tracking tools.
* Understanding of keyword research, search intent, website indexing, and organic search performance.
* Good writing skills and the ability to prepare clear content briefs and optimisation recommendations.
* Ability to interpret ranking and traffic data and explain what the figures do—and do not—demonstrate.
* Strong attention to detail when auditing websites, checking business listings, and reviewing performance reports.
* A methodical approach to investigating technical issues and identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Good organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks or campaigns at once.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to provide timely, accurate updates.
* Patience and consistency when managing campaigns where results develop over time.

**What to Expect in the Role**

You'll be expected to track SEO activity carefully, check your findings before reporting them, and communicate honestly about campaign performance. When rankings or traffic change unexpectedly, you should investigate the possible causes and explain what is known, what remains uncertain, and what action is recommended.

SEO requires ongoing attention rather than one-time fixes. We value consistent optimisation, realistic expectations, and prompt communication when a technical issue or campaign concern needs attention.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Sr. Marketing Data Analyst is responsible for transforming CRM, business development, and marketing data into clear, actionable insights that strengthen lead generation, support revenue growth, improve campaign performance, and guide strategic decision-making. This role serves as the business owner and primary administrator of the Company’s CRM system, with responsibility for system enhancements, reporting, dashboards, workflows, data integrity, user access, and ongoing optimization.

In addition to CRM ownership, this position analyzes data across the Company’s marketing technology ecosystem, including HubSpot, Google Analytics, digital advertising, SEO, website activity, email marketing, social media, campaign performance, and other tools used to measure customer engagement and marketing effectiveness. The role partners closely with Business Development, Marketing, IT, Corporate Training, operating subsidiaries, and leadership to turn data into actionable insights, recommendations, and measurable action to drive revenue growth.

**This role can be filled in one of the following Company offices: Houston, TX; Broomall, PA; or Tulsa, OK.**

**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

* Actively supports the Company’s commitment to safety and its Core Values.
* Represents the Company at all times with high moral standards while adhering to the Company’s Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.
* Serves as the primary point of contact, business owner, administrator, and internal champion for the Company’s CRM system.
* Leads CRM optimization efforts, including system enhancements, dashboards, reporting, workflows, data integrity, permissions, roles, user access, and overall system usability.
* Works closely with business stakeholders across operating subsidiaries, Business Development, Marketing, and IT to identify CRM needs, gather requirements, improve processes, and implement appropriate system solutions.
* Leads the CRM Technical Steering Team, including key end users and IT subject matter experts, to advance system functionality, adoption, governance, and long-term value.

* Maintains CRM data integrity through duplicate detection and resolution, data cleansing, discrepancy reporting, missing or malformed data correction, and improved data governance processes.
* Integrates CRM data with other marketing and business tools to provide a more complete view of customer, prospect, campaign, and business development activity.
* Develops and maintains dashboards, reports, scorecards, and visualizations that track KPIs and communicate performance trends to Business Development, Marketing, operating teams, and leadership.
* Analyzes performance across marketing channels, including CRM, HubSpot, Google Analytics, website activity, SEO, paid advertising, email marketing, social media, forms, landing pages, and campaign engagement.
* Builds and maintains measurement frameworks that evaluate campaign ROI, lead quality, funnel performance, customer journey activity, attribution, conversion rates, and marketing effectiveness.
* Develops, manages, and refines lead scoring models in HubSpot using firmographic, demographic, behavioral, web, email, and engagement data.
* Defines and monitors criteria for marketing-qualified and sales-qualified leads to help Business Development focus on higher-value prospects and opportunities.
* Cleans, organizes, and maintains HubSpot data, including properties, associations, workflows, lists, campaign data, and reporting structures.
* Collaborates with Business Development and Marketing to evaluate lead quality, campaign performance, customer engagement, and opportunities for optimization.
* Supports Business Development’s Strategic Account Management efforts.
* Conducts A/B testing, attribution analysis, ROI analysis, and campaign performance evaluation across digital channels, including email, paid media, web, SEO, and social.
* Translates complex data into actionable, executive-level insights by explaining what changed, why it matters, and what actions should be considered.
* Supports strategic initiatives by developing analysis, reporting, and recommendations that inform marketing priorities, budget decisions, campaign direction, and business development strategy.
* Partners with IT and data teams to improve data collection, system integration, security, scalability, and access to reliable marketing and CRM data.
* Works with Corporate Training and internal stakeholders to support user training, adoption, and best practices for CRM and related marketing tools.

* Prepares monthly, quarterly, ad hoc, and executive-level reports as required.
* Identifies opportunities to improve marketing efficiency, data accessibility, self-service reporting, and overall marketing analytics maturity.
* Performs other duties or responsibilities as required or assigned.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Information Systems, Data Science, Statistics, Business, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience may be considered.
* 5+ years of progressive experience in marketing analytics, CRM administration, business intelligence, data analysis, marketing operations, or a related data-driven marketing role.
* Strong working knowledge of CRM systems, including configuration of views, dashboards, reports, workflows, data structures, data integrity processes, and external reporting tools.
* Demonstrated experience pulling, cleaning, organizing, analyzing, and interpreting data

jobs.description:
**A****BOUT ROOTSTOCK**

Rootstock Software builds Cloud ERP for manufacturers, distributors, and supply chain teams, native to the Salesforce Platform. Our customers run inventory, production, and supply chain operations on Rootstock, and we are investing heavily in AI across the product and our go-to-market.

**THE ROLE**

We are hiring a technical, hands-on marketer to own paid acquisition and the growth engine behind roughly half of our top-of-funnel pipeline.

This role is built around budget ownership. You will run hundreds of thousands of dollars in Google Ads and AdRoll spend, decide where every dollar goes, and scale what works. You will also be the builder behind it: shipping pages, experiments, and automation in Claude Code, and running technical SEO, without waiting on an engineering queue.

It is a great fit for a digital or growth marketer a few years into their career who already owns paid budgets and leans technical, or for an associate-level consultant who has run strategy and execution for clients and wants to own it in-house.

***This is a remote position, based in the United States or Canada.***  
*Please, no agencies/recruiters.*

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* **Own paid performance.** Run Google Ads and AdRoll against our ICP terms and target accounts, scale spend into the hundreds of thousands, and make incremental spend decisions backed by data.
* **Drive technical SEO and conversion.** Find which terms and accounts convert to MQLs, run constant experiments, and grow top-of-funnel conversion week over week.
* **Build in Claude Code.** Ship and iterate on web pages, integrations, and automation that power the growth engine.
* **Measure what works.** Track performance across every channel, build the reporting you need to make spend decisions, and present results to leadership with confidence.
* **Shape AI and review-site discoverability.** Manage our presence on G2 and similar review sites, including how Rootstock gets surfaced and recommended by AI tools.
* **Support content and campaigns.** Contribute to case studies, sales enablement collateral, and persona-basedoutbound email and LinkedIn sequences as needed.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

The profile below is what we would like to see, but we are open to the right candidate. Strong analytical ability, theability to learn quickly, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves and contribute from day one matter more thanchecking every box.

* Ideally 3 to 5 years in growth, digital, paid, or performance marketing at a startup or B2B software company, or in an associate-level consulting role focused on marketing strategy and execution
* Direct ownership of ad spend and paid budgets in Google Ads, AdRoll, or similar, with accountability for results
* A technical, builder mindset: you are already experimenting with Claude Code or similar AI tools, and you are comfortable with automation, spreadsheets, SQL, or scripting
* Technical SEO experience, including keyword strategy and conversion optimization
* An analytical brain: you make spend decisions from data, not instinct
* A scrappy, high-ownership approach; you are comfortable running many experiments at once and grinding through the daily numbers
* Executive presence: you can own a number that matters to leadership and communicate results clearl

  

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Agency, consulting, or freelance experience managing paid budgets across multiple clients
* A founder or first-marketing-hire background at a startup
* Experience with ERP, supply chain, inventory, or manufacturing software
* Incrementality or A/B testing on paid channels
* Experience with G2 or other product review platforms
* Familiarity with Salesforce or Hubspot

**FIRST 90 DAYS**

The headline goal: scale our digital ad investment and prove it pays off.

* **Day 30:** Audit current paid, SEO, and conversion performance, learn the ICP and target accounts, and get your reporting baseline in place.
* **Day 60:** Launch your first wave of experiments across Google Ads, AdRoll, and technical SEO, and start reallocating spend toward what converts.
* **Day 90:** Run a scaled, measurable ad program with a clear line from spend to MQLs, and a roadmap for what you will build next.

**STEP 1:** Hiring Managers  
**STEP 2**: BDR Manager  
**STEP 3**: Sales Leadership  
**STEP 4:** CRO/Executive  
**STEP 5:** Case study/Panel interview

**The Basics:**

* **Work Authorization:** This position requires candidates to be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Rootstock is not able to sponsor, extend, or transfer work visas for this position now or in the future — this includes but is not limited to H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, and OPT/STEM OPT extensions. Candidates who will require sponsorship at any point during their employment will not be considered.

Base pay offered is based on market location and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.
