jobs.title: Content Marketing Lead, Insights
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM Labs is building the content engine that makes the market see TRM as the authority on crypto crime and financial-crime intelligence. As Content Marketing Lead for Research & Insights, you will turn the work of our Insights team into reports, articles, and campaigns that customers, journalists, and the wider crime-fighting community read, cite, and act on. You will own a proactive plan for which research stories TRM tells, when, and for whom, and make sure each one reaches the right audience.

The Impact You Will Have

Set the research content agenda. Build and own a proactive editorial plan with the Insights team that decides which findings become flagship reports, blog posts, social content, or media pitches, using AI to scan the research pipeline and surface the stories worth telling.
Turn research into a content engine. Carry findings from concept to published, distributed content and handle roughly 1 to 3 pieces a week, using AI workflows across review, drafting, and repurposing so quality holds as volume grows.
Decide the argument, then let AI accelerate production. Shape and pressure-test each narrative and its data yourself, then use AI to draft variants, headlines, and channel-specific cuts so more of your time goes to judgment and less to production.
Own distribution for everything you produce. Plan how each piece reaches its audience before it publishes, push it across owned, paid, and earned channels, and use AI to tailor it for social, the newsletter, and executive voice.
Grow TRM's search and AI-citation visibility. Produce the content that makes TRM the cited authority on priority themes, and use SEO and GEO tooling to find gaps and measure what moves.
Support media outreach. Work alongside TRM's head of Comms on journalist outreach for research releases, feed what you learn from coverage back into the content plan, and tune what works for the next release.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of B2B content marketing, editorial, or research-communications experience, with a portfolio of data- or research-based point-of-view work.
An AI-native approach: you use AI across research review, drafting, repurposing, and optimization, and you build workflows others can reuse.
Strong editorial judgment and the ability to strengthen complex, technical narratives without sacrificing accuracy, including when AI produced the first draft.
Experience owning a piece end to end, from concept through publication and distribution, and proactively planning content rather than only fulfilling requests.
A distribution mindset, with comfort using AI and analytics to measure and improve how content performs.
The ability to translate technical, data-driven material into clear, engaging content, using AI to adapt tone and format for different audiences.

About The Team

You will join Content & Brand Marketing within GTM Marketing, working hand in hand with the Insights team in Primary Intelligence and with Demand Gen and Comms.
The work is dedicated to data and research-based storytelling: TRM's credibility depends on the market seeing our intelligence and domain expertise, and this role scales that output.
It is a small, senior, AI-native team that expects ownership, pace, and strong judgment, and gives you real latitude to decide what TRM should be known for.
The hard part is intellectual: challenging researchers, finding the angle that makes a finding matter, and keeping quality high as volume grows.

Team Operating Rhythms

Distributed, not distant: the team works across the US and Europe/UK and keeps collaboration-hours overlap so ideas move quickly.
Async-first communication with regular syncs; the editorial calendar is the team's shared source of truth.
Close, continuous partnership with researchers, Demand Gen, and Comms rather than handoffs.
AI is part of the daily workflow, not an afterthought.

Required Online And Collaboration Hours

Schedule: Overlap with US-based team collaboration hours; specific hours confirmed at offer.

Travel Requirements

Schedule: Minimal; occasional team or event travel.
Frequency: Occasional.

Onsite Requirements

Schedule: None; fully remote.
Frequency: None.

Learn About TRM Speed In This Position

In your first 30 days, publish a research piece end to end, from concept to distribution, with a plan for how it reaches its audience.
Within 60 days, stand up an AI-assisted production workflow that lets the team ship 1 to 3 research pieces a week without adding headcount.
Within 90 days, move a flagship finding from idea to press-ready and placed, measurably lifting reach and search or AI-citation visibility on a priority theme.

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.
The estimated base salary range for this role is $140,000-$188,000.
Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.
Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.
Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.
References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.
Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.
Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To

Accelerate repeatable workflows
Structure and solve problems
Improve output quality
Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, You Should Expect

Priorities and targets to change quickly
Operating with a high degree of ambiguity
A high level of personal ownership and accountability
Close collaboration across teams and functions
Frequent, high-touch communication
Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking
A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.
Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.
Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy And Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

jobs.description:
About Pinterest

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Pinterest's Global Business Organization partners with advertisers, agencies and the wider industry to grow Pinterest's business. This role owns how Pinterest shows up with key industry associations and on the industry's biggest stages, from 3C Ventures, the IAB, the ANA and the MMA to marquee moments like CES and POSSIBLE. You'll be the connective tissue between Pinterest's leaders and the external industry across the U.S. and Canada, shaping visibility, influence and reputation across the advertising and marketing landscape.

What You'll Do

Serve as Pinterest's day-to-day contact for key industry associations — including 3C Ventures, the IAB, the ANA and the MMA — leading memberships and commitments, delivering against contractual obligations, and finding new ways to grow Pinterest's visibility and influence within these organizations.
Know the industry and these associations inside and out: ensure Pinterest is getting the most value out of each membership, and recommend where to deepen, sustain or exit a relationship when it's no longer earning its keep.
Partner with Sales leadership to make sure membership benefits (introductions, visibility, data, access) are actually being used and translating into value for the business.
Inform Pinterest's speakership strategy and lead execution across key U.S. and Canada industry moments — including CES and POSSIBLE — sourcing, pitching and securing speaking opportunities that match the right Pinterest voices to the right stages and ladder up to business priorities.
Develop programming — talking points, fireside chats, client panels and more — for Pinterest's owned events and industry events across the U.S. and Canada.
Support programming for occasional agency events (e.g., WPP Stream) and large client moments, such as an executive panel at a major client's company-wide gathering or a top-five agency holding company event.
Prepare and support internal spokespeople and executives for speaking engagements, developing briefs, talking points and narratives in partnership with Comms to establish a consistent, compelling Pinterest story across every stage moment.
Partner with senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing and Comms to prioritize the highest-impact opportunities and reconcile competing perspectives.
Track, measure and report on the value and impact of memberships, event investments and speaking engagements, and use those insights to recommend where to deepen, sustain or exit commitments.
Use AI to accelerate research, speaker briefing prep, event planning and reporting, while applying judgment and verification to establish correctness and quality.

What We're Looking For

Minimum of 8 years of experience in integrated marketing, industry relations, communications or event marketing, with expertise in sourcing and shaping speaking opportunities at major industry events.
Experience managing industry association memberships or similar external relationships, including evaluating their value and making recommendations on where to invest or pull back.
Experience preparing spokespeople and executives for stage moments, including developing briefs, talking points and narratives in partnership with communications teams.
Experience leading the end-to-end delivery of events and activations, including sponsorships, panels, logistics, budgets and timelines across multiple moments at once.
Experience building effective relationships with senior stakeholders, including Sales leadership, and reconciling perspectives to prioritize the highest-impact work with limited guidance.
Expertise in written and verbal communication, with the ability to represent a company credibly to external organizations, clients and agency partners.
Demonstrated experience using AI to accelerate research, briefing and reporting, with a clear approach to validating accuracy and quality.
Strong track record of critical evaluation and verification of AI-assisted work, with high integrity and ownership: you protect sensitive data, avoid over-reliance on AI and remain accountable for final decisions and deliverables.
Willingness to travel for key industry events, client events and speaking engagements as needed.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as marketing or communications, or equivalent experience.

Relocation Statement:

This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement

We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.

jobs.title: Paid Media Buyer - NAM
jobs.description:
Description

Regional Media Buyer — Paid Media

Description

At Xe, we live currencies. We provide a comprehensive range of currency services and products, including our Currency Converter, Market Analysis, Currency Data API and quick, easy, secure Money Transfers for individuals and businesses. We leverage technology to deliver these services through our website, mobile app and by phone. Last year, we helped over 300 million people access information about the currencies that matter to them and over 225,000 people used us to send money overseas.

About This Role

We are looking for a Regional Media Buyer to build, launch, and optimise paid media campaigns for your assigned region. This is a hands-on execution role at the core of how Xe acquires customers. Day to day, you will be inside the platforms — building campaigns, managing budgets, and tracking performance across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Apple Search Ads.

Xe runs paid media as a centralised, best-practice-led function. That means you will not be inventing your own way of doing things in isolation: you will execute against shared briefs, campaign structures, and naming conventions, apply the standards the global paid media team sets, and keep your region's setup consistent with the rest of the business. Your value is in flawless, fast, and accurate execution — campaigns that go live correctly, budgets that pace to plan, and data that everyone can trust.

We believe in using AI to optimise how we work. We want someone who is AI-forward — using it to build smarter systems and integrations, speed up competitor research, and take the manual weight out of execution and reporting — while keeping their own judgment firmly in the driver's seat. AI is a tool that makes a sharp buyer sharper; it is not a substitute for understanding the platforms, the data, and the strategy behind the work.

You will report to the Global Manager of Paid Media and work closely with the other regional buyers, as well as with design, analytics, and the wider marketing team. This is a strong role for someone early in their paid media career who wants to go deep on execution across every major channel and grow within a global team.

OUR PRINCIPLES

AMBITION - We dream big, try things out and always ask "why not?" and "what if?" We're ambitious in our thinking and our delivery.

RESPONSIBILITY - We get involved, bring our perspective, and are always open to new ideas. We take personal responsibility.

COMMUNITY - We value a sense of belonging, trusting each other and encouraging authenticity. We contribute to our community.

Roles & Responsibilities

Building & Executing Campaigns

Build, launch, and manage paid campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, and YouTube), Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Apple Search Ads for your assigned region.
Set up campaigns to the shared standard — consistent structures, naming conventions, tracking, and audience/keyword configuration — so your region's account is clean, organized, and easy to read.
Write and traffic ad copy, keywords, audiences, and creative assets into each platform, and coordinate with design to get the assets you need on time.
Turn briefs from the global paid media team into live, correctly configured campaigns, and get them to market quickly and accurately.

Optimization & Best Practices

Stay current on platform changes, new ad formats, beta features, and best-practice updates across Google, Meta, TikTok, and Apple Search Ads, and put them into practice in your accounts.
Run day-to-day optimization — bids, budgets, audiences, keywords, negatives, placements, and creative rotation — to improve performance against targets.
Support and execute structured tests (creative, audience, bidding, landing page) and document what you learn so it can be applied across regions.
Flag opportunities and risks early and bring ideas for what to try next.

Working AI-Forward

Use AI tools to work faster and smarter — drafting and iterating ad copy, generating and analyzing competitor research, summarizing performance data, and taking the repetitive work out of setup and reporting.
Look for ways to build AI into your systems, integrations, and workflows so your region runs more efficiently, and share what works with the wider paid media team.
Apply your own judgment to everything AI produces — validating outputs, sense-checking against the data, and owning the final decision. We want AI accelerating your work, not doing your job for you.

Budget Management

Manage and pace campaign budgets to plan — monitor daily and weekly spend, avoid over- and under-delivery, and reallocate within your region as performance dictates.
Keep accurate records of spend by channel and campaign, and reconcile against the plan.
Escalate pacing issues, budget shortfalls, or unexpected cost changes promptly.

Data Tracking & Reporting

Own accurate tracking for your campaigns — UTMs, conversion tracking, and correct tagging — so results are measured cleanly and consistently.
Pull performance data from each platform and Xe's reporting tools, and maintain clear, up-to-date reporting on the metrics that matter (spend, CAC, conversions, and channel efficiency).
Use the shared measurement framework and metric definitions so your region's numbers line up with the rest of the business.
Surface insights from the data — what's working, what isn't, and what you'd change — in regular reporting to the Global Manager of Paid Media.

Position Requirements

1–3 years of hands-on experience building and managing paid media campaigns, ideally in-house or at an agency.
Direct, in-platform experience with at least two of Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Apple Search Ads, and the appetite to become strong across all four.
Comfortable building campaigns from scratch — structures, keywords/audiences, ad copy, and tracking — and keeping accounts organized and consistent.
Solid understanding of paid media fundamentals: bidding, budgeting, audience targeting, and the core metrics (CPC, CPA/CAC, ROAS, conversion rate).
Experience managing and pacing campaign budgets, with a careful, detail-oriented approach to spend.
Comfortable working with data: pulling performance reports, setting up conversion tracking and UTMs, and reading results accurately.
Highly organised and reliable, able to manage multiple live campaigns at once and follow shared processes and standards closely.
Eager to keep up with a fast-changing landscape and put new platform features and best practices into use.
AI-forward: you actively use AI tools to speed up execution, research, and reporting, and to build better systems and integrations — while relying on your own judgment to check the output and make the calls.
Strong communicator who can report clearly on performance and collaborate across a distributed team.
Experience with Google Analytics, Looker, or similar reporting/BI tools is a plus.
Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, or another regulated, multi-market business is a plus.

Perks & Benefits

Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
401K Plan with Match
Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Paid Vacation / Sick Leave
Hybrid Work Schedule
Tuition Assistance
Growth Opportunities
Corporate gatherings, team bonding events, and much more!
Plumm Mental Health and Wellbeing
Volunteering day for a charity of your choice

Xe offers a competitive salary and benefits package. The reasonable estimated pay for this (Salary Exempt or Non-exempt hourly rate) role ranges from $110,000- $130,000. Actual compensation is based upon factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Xe offers comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental and vision benefits, a 401(K) plan, Paid Vacation / Sick Leave and more.

We want Xe to be a great place to work and to ensure that our communities are represented across our workforce. A vital part of this is ensuring we are a truly inclusive organization that encourages diversity in all respects.

Xe is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment regardless of age, national origin, race, color, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at recruitment@xe.com.

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Shape What Comes Next

About Legence

Legence (Nasdaq: LGN) is a leading provider of engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance services for mission-critical systems in buildings. The company specializes in designing, fabricating, and installing complex HVAC, process piping, and other mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems—enhancing energy efficiency, reliability, and sustainability in new and existing facilities. Legence also delivers long-term performance through strategic upgrades and holistic solutions. Serving some of the world’s most technically demanding sectors, Legence counts over 60% of the Nasdaq-100 Index among its clients.

Content Development & Social Media Manager

Reports to: Vice President, Marketing, Legence
Position Type: Direct-Hire / Full-Time
Location: Remote; Ability to Travel up to 10%

Position Overview

Legence is seeking an experienced Content Development & Social Media Manager to lead the development and activation of compelling content across Legence and its portfolio of Business Unit brands.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role for a strong writer, storyteller, and social media strategist who can translate complex technical expertise, projects, and business priorities into clear, engaging content for a range of audiences and channels.

This individual will help bring consistency and scale to social media across a multi-brand organization. They will partner closely with Business Unit marketing contacts, subject matter experts, executives, creative resources, communications, and the enterprise marketing team to strengthen the visibility of Legence and its companies while preserving the distinct expertise and voice of each brand.

Experience within construction, engineering, architecture, consulting, energy, the built environment or another complex B2B industry is strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Content Strategy & Development

Develop high-quality content that strengthens the visibility, reputation, and market positioning of Legence and its Business Units.
Proactively identify compelling stories, projects, expertise, trends, and perspectives from across the enterprise and turn them into meaningful marketing content.
Write and edit content across a variety of formats, including:
Website and landing page copy
Thought leadership articles
Case studies and project profiles
Social media content
Executive and subject matter expert thought leadership
Email and digital campaigns
Industry and end-market content
Marketing collateral
Video scripts and supporting copy
Press releases
Campaign messaging

Interview executives, technical leaders, subject matter experts and project teams to develop credible, differentiated content.
Translate complex engineering, construction, maintenance, sustainability, energy, and technical concepts into clear, compelling stories for both technical and nontechnical audiences.
Repurpose strong content across multiple formats and channels to extend its value and reach.
Maintain editorial quality and ensure content reflects appropriate voice, messaging and brand standards while recognizing the distinct identities of individual Business Units.
Partner with marketing, communications, and creative teams to identify opportunities for integrated campaigns and storytelling.

Social Media Strategy & Management

Help lead and execute social media strategy across Legence and supported Business Unit brands, working alongside the communications team who leads culture, recruiting, and investor related content.
Develop and maintain editorial calendars in collaboration with Business Unit marketing contacts, communications, and enterprise stakeholders.
Manage the development, review, approval, scheduling, and publishing of social content.
This role is not managing direct reports or a team.
Draft and edit social copy spanning corporate and industry content, projects, thought leadership, services, and Business Unit stories.
Adapt content appropriately across Legence and Business Unit channels while maintaining alignment with enterprise brand and messaging standards.
Manage day-to-day social media workflows using Sprout Social and Asana.
Coordinate with creative resources on social graphics, photography, video, and other visual assets.
Support employee advocacy and amplification programs designed to expand the reach of Legence and Business Unit content.
Monitor social channels, comments, messages, mentions and relevant industry conversations, escalating issues when appropriate.
Identify opportunities to amplify strong Business Unit stories across enterprise channels.

Campaigns & Digital Content

Partner with the broader marketing team to develop integrated content campaigns supporting priority markets, services, business initiatives and growth objectives.
Develop content that can be activated across social, web, email, thought leadership and other digital channels.
Support campaign development and execution through HubSpot, where appropriate.
Collaborate with marketing and Business Unit teams on targeted thought leadership and campaigns tied to services and priority market sectors.
Apply SEO and emerging AI-search/GEO best practices to digital content to strengthen discoverability.
Identify opportunities to extend the life and value of content by strategically repurposing it across audiences, brands and channels.

Analytics & Optimization

Track and evaluate content and social performance to understand which topics, formats and channels generate the strongest engagement and results.
Use insights from Sprout Social, web analytics, HubSpot, and other available platforms to continuously improve content strategy.
Evaluate performance across content categories, formats and Business Units.
Translate data and performance trends into clear recommendations for future content, campaigns and channel strategy, aligning with Legence’s Data and Analytics Manager.

Required

5–8 years of professional experience in content development, content marketing, social media, digital marketing, communications, or a related discipline.
Exceptional writing, editing and storytelling skills, with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to communicate complex subjects clearly and compellingly.
Demonstrated experience developing content for multiple formats, audiences, and digital channels.
Hands-on experience managing corporate or B2B social media channels and editorial calendars.
Strong understanding of how content, social media, and digital channels work together to build brand visibility and support broader business objectives.
Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple simultaneous priorities and deadlines.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to develop productive relationships across functions, businesses, and levels of an organization.
Ability to work independently, proactively identify opportunities, and move projects forward without extensive direction.

Preferred

Experience within construction, engineering, architecture, consulting, energy, sustainability, commercial real estate or another technical B2B environment.
Experience working within a multi-brand, multi-business or decentralized enterprise organization.
Experience supporting multiple businesses with different audiences, priorities, and levels of internal marketing support.

Experience with Asana or another enterprise work management platform.
Experience with HubSpot or comparable marketing automation technology.
Familiarity with web CMS platforms, SEO, AI search/GEO principles, digital analytics and content performance measurement.
Experience developing executive and subject matter expert thought leadership.

Position Overview

Riviera Dining Group is seeking a creative, visually driven, and highly organized Social Media Manager to oversee social media execution across its hospitality brands. This role requires a strong understanding of social media, nightlife culture, luxury hospitality, and visual storytelling, with the ability to capture compelling content and translate live experiences into engaging digital narratives.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable managing online communities, capturing on-site content, curating photoshoots and video shoots, and collaborating with internal teams to ensure key events, offerings, and activations are effectively communicated and promoted across social platforms. This individual must also demonstrate strong communication and critical thinking skills, proactively identify opportunities for improvement, and confidently bring forward strategic proposals and solutions that support business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Social Media & Community Management

Manage daily community engagement across assigned brand social media accounts, including responding to direct messages, comments, tags, and guest inquiries in a timely and professional manner
Maintain each brand’s unique tone of voice, visual identity, and digital presence
Actively engage with influencers, DJs, tastemakers, industry professionals, and relevant local communities to build brand awareness and strengthen online engagement
Monitor social media activity, identify relevant trends, and participate in timely conversations that align with each brand
Ensure all social media interactions reflect RDG’s standards of luxury hospitality and guest experience

On-Site Event Coverage & Content Creation

Attend on-site events, activations, and special events to capture real-time social content
Capture high-quality photo and video content using phone and professional cameras, with an understanding of framing, lighting, composition, and movement
Identify compelling moments, details, and experiences that translate into engaging Instagram Stories, Reels, and other social-first content
Publish timely, engaging Stories and live updates during events while maintaining each brand’s established visual direction
Stay informed about nightlife culture, music trends, and relevant events to identify opportunities for engaging and culturally relevant content

Photoshoot & Video Shoot Curation

Collaborate on the ideation, planning, and execution of photoshoots and video shoots across assigned brands

The Director of Growth Marketing is a member of WPI's in-house team of experts in marketing strategy, messaging, creative, social media, multimedia, and production management. Under the direction of the AVP of Marketing Communications and in collaboration with campus partners, this team leads WPI's integrated brand strategy and the campaigns that support it. Growth Strategy

Lead the university's enrollment growth marketing strategy across the full student acquisition funnel, driving awareness, audience acquisition, inquiries, engagement, and pipeline growth through integrated multichannel campaigns, digital nurture programs, and performance optimization across paid, owned, experiential, and CRM-enabled channels.

Use analytics, attribution, and performance insights to optimize marketing investment and campaign effectiveness.

The Social Media Marketing Manager (Contract) will be responsible for developing and executing social media strategies to enhance brand awareness, foster customer engagement, drive online reviews, and support business objectives. Strategy Development: Design and implement a comprehensive social media strategy aligned with Lavu’s goals and budget, focusing on platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Linkedin, Google reviews and X to increase brand visibility, customer engagement.

Kain Media is looking for an experienced social media manager and content creator for a luxury custom homebuilder in the Vail Valley.

THE OPPORTUNITY

You’ll work with beautiful homes, active construction projects and the people behind them. An existing photography library, brand guidance and planned monthly professional video shoots will provide a foundation for your work.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing
jobs.description:
What We Do

Build the insurance behind the physical world.

The world is building data centers, energy projects, hospitals, schools, and critical infrastructure. Every one of those projects needs insurance to move forward. Yet the process of getting that insurance still depends on scattered documents, manual work, and weeks of back-and-forth.

Shepherd is rebuilding commercial insurance with software, data, AI, and deep underwriting expertise. We started in construction and energy, where understanding the specifics of a project matters and better decisions have consequences far beyond a screen.

We develop insurance products, decide which risks to insure and how to price them, and partner with established insurers to back the coverage. We own the platform our team uses to turn complex submissions into coverage for the builders and operators shaping the world around us.

Real problems. Real ownership.

Our engineers, designers, underwriters, and actuaries build together. The problems span turning messy documents into reliable data, making pricing more precise, and designing AI agents that can take on increasingly complex underwriting work.

The ambition is a platform where experts spend more time on judgment and relationships, supported by software that handles the work around them. Join us to build systems whose decisions help real projects get built.

630+ customers / $500B+ insured project value

Our investors

Capital to build. Partners to grow with.

$67M total funding / $42M Series B in March 2026

Shepherd is backed by Intact Private Capital, Costanoa Ventures, Spark Capital, Susa Ventures, and Y Combinator. In March 2026, we announced a $42M Series B led by Intact Private Capital, bringing our total funding to $67M.

Intact is also a capacity partner. Alongside its investment, Intact works with Shepherd to bring insurance products to market. That relationship connects our platform and underwriting expertise with the resources of a global insurer.

A bigger opportunity ahead

We are investing in new insurance products, our underwriting team, and the path toward autonomous underwriting. For the people joining Shepherd, that means the chance to shape both the technology and the business it makes possible.

Our backing brings together investors who build technology companies and partners who understand insurance. We are building a company that earns the confidence of both.

Director of Marketing

About The Role

As Director of Marketing, you will own how Shepherd reaches and engages commercial insurance brokers, both online and in person. Brokers are our distribution channel, and marketing in commercial insurance has historically been limited. We think there's an opportunity to do things differently.

You'll build our brand, develop content that brokers actually want to engage with, and run events that bring the right people together. You'll work closely with underwriting, business development, and leadership to make sure our marketing programs are reaching the right brokers and ultimately driving more submissions.

This is a hands-on role. You'll set the strategy, run programs yourself, experiment with new ideas, and build the team as we grow.

In This Role, You Will

Field marketing and events

Build our events program, from smaller broker dinners and roundtables to roadshows and activations at major industry conferences.
Work with underwriting and business development to identify the right brokers, offices, and markets to target.
Create repeatable event playbooks that our teams can run across different regions, with clear follow-up and measurement.
Come up with new ways to bring brokers together and give them a reason to spend time with Shepherd.

Content and digital marketing

Own our content strategy across LinkedIn, email, newsletters, and other channels where we can reach brokers.
Work with underwriters and other subject matter experts to create content that's useful, interesting, and relevant to our audience.
Build campaigns that keep Shepherd top of mind with brokers, whether they've never worked with us or submit regularly.
Experiment with different formats and channels, measure what works, and double down on the ones that drive engagement.

Brand marketing

Build Shepherd's brand in the commercial insurance market, particularly among the brokerages and producers we want to work with.
Develop creative campaigns that help us stand out from traditional carriers and MGAs.
Own how Shepherd shows up across our events, content, campaigns, and other marketing channels.
Find new ways to get Shepherd in front of the right audience, beyond the standard insurance marketing playbook.

Measurement and team

Work with revenue operations and analytics to measure the impact of our programs, from broker engagement to first submission and repeat submissions.
Own marketing priorities, budgets, and reporting. Know what's working, what's not, and where we should invest more.
Hire, coach, and grow the marketing team, and manage the agencies and vendors behind our programs.

About You

You're a marketing leader who wants to build something from the ground up. You've run successful events, built brands, and developed content that gets people to pay attention. You understand how marketing can support a relationship-driven business, and you can point to programs you've built and the results they produced.

You're creative, but you're also an operator. You like coming up with ideas, and you care just as much about getting them done. You're excited by the opportunity to do your best work in an industry where there's still a lot of room to try something new.

You'd be a great fit if you have:

8+ years in B2B marketing, including experience owning programs or leading teams at a high-growth company.
A track record of building and running field marketing programs, including proprietary events, conferences, and other in-person activations.
Strong content marketing experience, including developing content strategies and growing engagement across digital channels.
Good brand instincts. You know what makes a company stand out, and you've helped build a brand that people recognize and trust.
Experience marketing to a professional audience, particularly in a business where relationships matter.
A data-driven approach. You set goals, measure results, and change course when something isn't working.
Creativity, hustle, and strong execution. You come up with ideas, do the work to bring them to life, and aren't afraid to try something that hasn't been done before.
AI-native working habits. You use AI tools to move faster, produce content, and find better ways to run programs.
Experience in insurance, insurtech, fintech, construction tech, or another B2B industry is a plus, but not required.

How we work

Shepherd runs on four values. Here's what each one means in this seat.

Think big, build big. We exist to protect progress and the industries that rely on it. The work here is aimed at a system that runs on its own, and the roadmap gets sequenced backward from that rather than forward from what's easy.
Win together. We rise as one. We support each other, raise the bar, and celebrate collective success. Come set a standard the rest of the team inherits.
Cross the aisle. Collaboration wins. We listen deeply, work across boundaries, and prioritize shared success over individual lanes. The best product calls here come from engineers who've sat with underwriters and underwriters who understand where the model breaks, and much of this job is listening closely enough on both sides to make that happen.
Go get it. We act with urgency, move with confidence, take smart risks, and push forward with intention. Nobody hands you the roadmap, the data, or the meeting invite. You pull the failing runs, book the time with the underwriters, and decide what matters.

Benefits

🏥 Premium Healthcare

100% contribution to health, dental, and vision

🥕 Fertility benefits and family building support

🏖️ Flexible PTO

Flexibility to take the time off, recharge, and perform

🥗 Daily lunches, dinners, and snacks

We work together, and enjoy meals together too

🖥️ SF, NYC, Dallas-Fort Worth, Chicago and LA Offices

📚 Professional Development

Access to premium coaching, including leadership development

🏦 Competitive
401(k) Plan

🐶 Dog-friendly office

Plenty of dogs to play with and make friends with in the SF office

Marketing Manager - Las Vegas Resident Shows

Sales, Marketing & Communications

Full-Time Position

Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group (“CDSEG”) is seeking a dynamic and results-driven Marketing Manager to lead promotional and strategic marketing efforts for our Las Vegas resident shows.

Reporting to the Director of Marketing, this role is responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing integrated marketing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and ticket sales. The ideal candidate is a creative thinker with strong analytical skills, thrives in a fast-paced entertainment environment, and is passionate about storytelling and audience growth.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Execution

In collaboration with the Director of Marketing, and Senior Director of Marketing & Brand, define and implement the annual marketing strategies for Cirque du Soleil Las Vegas resident shows
Develop and oversee comprehensive marketing plans to reach both visitor and local audiences, maximizing visibility across traditional, digital, and experiential channels
Monitor performance against KPIs, proactively adjusting strategies to meet revenue and attendance goals within approved budget parameters
Identify new opportunities and innovative marketing tactics to test and refine throughout the year

Market & Media Oversight

Serve as the in-market marketing lead, providing ongoing assessments of visibility, competitive positioning, and new opportunities across Las Vegas

Ensure compliance with all partnership agreements and coordinate approvals as needed

Budget & Administration

Track and evaluate campaign results, compiling post-campaign recaps and actionable insights for leadership
Oversee vendors and production schedules to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery of assets

Additional Duties

Support cross-show portfolio marketing initiatives when applicable
Complete all other job-related duties as assigned

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field
At least 3 years of marketing experience, preferably in entertainment, hospitality, or live events
Proven track record managing integrated marketing campaigns from strategy to execution
Strong analytical, project management, and presentation skills
Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities across all organizational levels
Experience managing external agencies and cross-functional teams
Proficient in Microsoft Office and comfortable analyzing data to inform strategy

Verification of the right to work in the United States for Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group, as demonstrated by completion of the Form I-9 upon hire and the submission of acceptable documentation (as noted on the Form I-9) verifying one’s identity and work authorization

As you can imagine, working with a circus can be quite different from other organizations, and at Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group, we embrace these differences loudly with enthusiasm. Description

About Us: Born in artistry, built for real life, and fueled by a global community, Morphe delivers high-performance, high-design beauty without the prestige price tag. Leveraging exceptional product development, regulatory, and supply chain capabilities, we make innovative products that invite creativity and celebrate the freedom to look how you want, when you want. Join us in shaping what’s next in beauty.

Summary of Position
The Senior Manager, Social Media sets the strategic vision for our social presence, building an ownable, unmistakable brand point of view across every channel and translating it into a content system the team can execute against day to day. This role strategically programs content, develops ownable content series and a distinct aesthetic, and keeps the brand consistently ahead of trend and culture. The Senior Manager owns performance rigor across the social portfolio, leads the brand’s expansion into new channels including YouTube and Pinterest, and manages a team of two. This is a strategy-first role with a clear path to Director within two years for the right candidate.

Principle Accountabilities

Set and own cross-channel social strategy across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, and emerging platforms, translating brand and marketing priorities into a distinct, ownable social point of view.
Strategically program content: develop ownable content series, franchises, and a consistent aesthetic that build brand recognition over time, not one-off posts, and keep them evolving as trends, formats, and culture shift.
Push the brand consistently on trend and cultural relevance, spotting content opportunities and white space before they peak, and coaching the team to move on them quickly and confidently.
Build out and scale the brand’s YouTube and Pinterest strategies, and lead early strategic thinking on a future Reddit presence.
Manage, coach, and develop a team of two direct reports, the Social Media Manager and Social Creative Manager, setting clear priorities, giving regular feedback, and building each of their growth paths.
Own performance rigor: track TY/LY (this-year vs. last-year) KPIs across every channel, ensure the team consistently delivers against agreed metrics, and turn results into next actions and resourcing decisions.
Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Influencer, Creative, and Retail teams to keep brand voice and campaign moments consistent across owned and earned channels.
Own strategy recaps and performance reporting up to leadership, translating data into a clear narrative on what’s working and what’s next.
Represent social strategy in cross-functional planning, ensuring social has a seat at the table for major launches, campaigns, and brand moments.

Key Working Relationships

Direct reports: Social Media Manager and Social Creative Manager.
Cross-functional partners: Marketing, Influencer Marketing, Creative Services, Copy, and Retail/commercial teams.
External: content creators, agency partners, and platform partners as needed.

Required Skills & Experience

5+ years of social media marketing/strategy experience, including at least 1–2 years directly managing people. Beauty or CPG industry highly preferred.
Demonstrated experience building ownable content series, franchises, or a distinct brand aesthetic that scaled over time.
Experience across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube required; Pinterest experience strongly preferred; familiarity with Reddit’s community dynamics a plus.
Proven track record owning TY/LY performance reporting and translating results into strategy.
Experience managing and developing direct reports, with a track record of growing team members into more senior roles.
Highly organized and data-driven, with strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
Proficient with Microsoft Office; familiar with social publishing and analytics tools (e.g., Dash Hudson) and content tools (CapCut, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite).
Ability to work cross-functionally across marketing, creative, influencer, and retail teams.

Travel for events (photoshoots, store openings, influencer activations) on a case-by-case basis.

Must be able to perform essential functions (with or without an accommodation) without posing a "direct threat" to the health and safety to self or others.

jobs.description:
At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze®, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses.

Early Warning follows a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment.

Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship.

Overall Purpose

The Director of Marketing Technology and Transformation is a member of the Marketing Operations team, whose mission is to enable our people to do the best work of their lives. This role leads improvement in how Marketing works and in the technology that supports Early Warning’s portfolio of brands, including Zelle, Paze, and Certos.

This role owns Marketing’s technology roadmap and leads work to simplify processes, automate repetitive work, and use AI responsibly. The Director works across Marketing and with Technology, Data, Legal, Risk, Compliance, and other teams to identify the most important problems to solve, recommend the right approach, and move solutions from idea through implementation and adoption.

As a hands-on transformation leader, the Director will identify opportunities for Marketing to operate faster and safely while increasing impact. This leader will take a network-first approach, creating shared processes, platforms, automations, and responsibly deployed AI capabilities that improve delivery across Marketing and advance our ambition to become an AI-native company.

The Director is responsible for making sure Marketing’s technology investments work together, solve clear business needs, and can support multiple brands where appropriate. This includes recommending when to improve an existing tool, integrate systems, build a new capability, buy technology, retire tools that are no longer delivering enough value, or use AI to increase Marketing’s bandwidth faster than headcount.

Essential Functions

Marketing Technology Strategy and Roadmap

Own and maintain Marketing’s multi-year MarTech technology roadmap across Zelle, Paze, Certos, and shared Marketing functions
Set clear priorities for technology improvements with a network-first approach, based on business need, expected value, cost, risk, ease of use, and ability to support Marketing priorities
Recommend when Marketing should improve an existing tool, integrate systems, build a capability, purchase new technology, or retire a tool
Develop business cases and funding recommendations for major technology investments and present recommendations and tradeoffs to senior leaders
Work with Technology, Data and Sales Operations to deliver the platforms and solutions needed for Marketing's CRM, brand health and campaign attribution initiatives

Process Improvement and Transformation

Lead efforts to improve the Marketing processes that have the greatest impact on speed, capacity, quality, cost, or risk
Map important processes from beginning to end to understand to identify friction points and redesign processes using automation, AI, reusable components, and self-service capabilities
Establish reusable processes, standards, platforms, and self-service capabilities across brands while preserving legitimate business, regulatory, and customer requirements
Define transformation success measures and track adoption, capacity creation, cycle-time improvement, cost savings, risk reduction, and other business outcomes

Reengineer How Marketing Works, Inclusive Of AI

Identify, prototype, and lead delivery of automations, AI-enabled workflows, integrations, and lightweight tools that improve speed, quality, or capacity
Partner with Legal, Risk, Technology, and enterprise AI teams to move promising solutions from discovery and minimum viable capability through testing, release, adoption, iteration while meeting security, privacy, and governance requirements
Support Marketing's contribution Marketing's contribution to Early Warning's AI-native ambition by working with internal and external partners to develop responsible, scalable AI enablement programs for marketers, reusing enterprise capabilities and standards wherever possible
Serve as Marketing’s lead for marketing technology and process transformation with senior leaders and cross-functional partners
Identify and prioritize practical uses of AI and automation that can reduce manual work, improve quality, increase capacity, or help Marketing make better decisions. Lead new solutions from initial idea and testing through approval, implementation, adoption, and broader use
Work with Legal, Risk, Compliance, Technology, and enterprise AI teams to make sure new capabilities meet security, privacy, legal, and governance requirements
Help establish common approaches, tools, and training so marketers can use AI responsibly in their everyday work
Manage key technology and vendor relationships, including vendor evaluation, selection, performance, cost, and ongoing value

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
Typically has 12 or more years of experience or demonstrated portfolio consistent with experience required of the role in marketing technology, marketing automation, product management, solutions architecture, process improvement, or related disciplines
Demonstrated experience developing multi-year strategies, roadmaps, investment cases, and executive recommendations for complex technology or transformation portfolios
Proven ability to develop business cases, evaluate technology investments, manage vendors, and communicate recommendations to senior leaders
Demonstrated leadership of complex, cross-functional teams and enterprise transformation initiatives, establish alignment across functions, and drive decisions without relying solely on formal authority
Effective communication and presentation skills, with demonstrated ability to translate complex technology and transformation topics into clear business implications, investment choices, risks, and recommendations

Preferred Qualifications

Experience modernizing marketing technology or operations in a regulated, high-control, or complex enterprise environment
Demonstrated use of generative AI, decision automation, or intelligent workflow tools to solve real business-process problems
Product-management, process-improvement, change-management, architecture, or agile delivery training or certification

jobs.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

UCANZ Marketing Operations, Senior Manager

POSITION PREMISE

The UCANZ Marketing Operations, Senior Manager is responsible for turning global and regional marketing priorities into coordinated, localized, production-ready and successfully delivered marketing activity across the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and South Africa.

The role owns the regional execution layer of the marketing operating model, connecting UCANZ Marketing with Crunchyroll’s global capabilities across Integrated Planning, Campaign Operations, Marketing Production, Global Localization and Marketing Delivery. This leader ensures campaigns are operationally planned, assets are produced and localized to regional requirements, dependencies are managed and final materials are delivered accurately and on time across relevant channels and partners.

A critical responsibility is end-to-end management of marketing localization across UCANZ. The Sr. Manager coordinates translation, transcreation, cultural adaptation, versioning, approvals, quality checks and delivery for assets originating from global campaigns or created for regional initiatives, while partnering with Global Localization on standards, technology, vendors and quality frameworks.

The role reports to UCANZ Regional Marketing leadership or the designated Regional Operations leader and works closely with Campaign Operations, Marketing Production, Marketing Delivery, Regional Marketing, Title Marketing, Brand Management, Creative Services, Partnerships, Social, CRM, Paid Media, Content, Curation & Programming and global centers of excellence. Success requires exceptional organization, operational judgment, strong communication and the ability to scale consistent processes while representing UCANZ market, channel, language and cultural needs. The role will ideally be based in Los Angeles or San Francisco.

KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY

UCANZ MARKETING OPERATIONS & EXECUTION

Own the operational coordination of UCANZ marketing activity, translating global and regional strategies into executable plans, milestones, asset requirements, localization needs, dependencies and delivery schedules.
Maintain an integrated view of regional marketing readiness and ensure activities move effectively from planning through execution and launch.
Coordinate multiple campaigns, markets, asset types, stakeholders and deadlines while maintaining clear ownership and accountability.
Establish operating standards that enable accurate, timely and scalable execution across UCANZ channels and partners.
Anticipate execution risks, surface decisions and proactively remove blockers that could affect quality, timing, budget or campaign activation.

REGIONAL INTEGRATED PLANNING

Partner with Integrated Planning to incorporate regional priorities, launches, campaigns, tentpoles, local initiatives and market requirements into broader global marketing plans.
Translate global plans into actionable UCANZ timelines, workstreams and readiness checkpoints.
Provide early visibility into local requirements, resource constraints, localization lead times, partner specifications and execution risks.
Coordinate planning inputs across Regional Marketing, Content, Social, CRM, Paid Media, Partnerships, Brand, PR and other stakeholders to create one integrated regional view.
Ensure campaign plans reflect regional priorities while leveraging common global processes, technology, production capabilities and standards.

END-TO-END MARKETING LOCALIZATION

Manage localization workflows for global and regional marketing assets, including copy, key art, trailers, video, social assets, paid-media creative, CRM materials, partner assets, promotional content and other campaign deliverables.
Coordinate translation, transcreation, cultural adaptation, versioning, review, approvals, quality assurance and final delivery against campaign deadlines.
Partner with Global Localization on terminology, technology, vendors, workflows and quality frameworks while retaining operational accountability for UCANZ readiness.
Ensure localized assets are accurate, brand-appropriate, culturally relevant, technically compliant and available in the required formats and destinations.
Identify opportunities to streamline regionalization, reduce duplication and create scalable approaches to campaign adaptation across the four markets.

MARKETING PRODUCTION & ASSET COORDINATION

Partner with Marketing Production and Creative Services to communicate regional production and localization requirements early and define necessary versions, formats and specifications.

jobs.title: Manager, Digital Acquisition, Marketing & Engagement
jobs.description:
Headquartered in Colorado Springs, Colorado, Focus on the Family has nearly 700 employees who work to achieve the mission of enriching the lives of families, engaging the culture, advocating for life and spreading the Gospel of Jesus Christ. The work is meaningful, the culture is rewarding, and the purpose is eternal.

The Manager, Digital Acquisition, Marketing & Engagement position exists to lead the development, execution, measurement, and optimization of Focus on the Family’s digital acquisition and discovery strategies across paid digital advertising, traditional organic search (SEO), and AI/answer engine search (AEO/GEO). This role oversees paid campaign strategy and performance across Google Ads, Meta, and other social media platforms, while leading SEO and GEO strategies to strengthen organic search visibility and AI-driven discovery. Using tools such as Google Analytics, SEMrush, and AI-search intelligence platforms, this position translates campaign performance and search insights into actionable strategies that increase awareness, engagement, and measurable ministry outcomes.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

Is accountable for developing and optimizing an integrated search discovery strategy across paid search, organic search (SEO), and AI/answer engine search (AEO/GEO), with the objective of increasing Focus on the Family's visibility and constituent engagement across digital properties.
Is accountable for the optimization of paid search opportunities, both revenue-generating and ministry-focused, that lead to constituent engagement across Focus on the Family digital properties.
Designs and executes campaign strategies across Google Ads accounts, campaigns include ministry-focused, Ecommerce, Google Grant, and Fundraising, to maximize stewardship and the effectiveness of every dollar invested.
Designs and executes campaign strategies across Meta Ads and other social media ad accounts, campaigns include ministry-focused, Ecommerce, and Fundraising, to maximize stewardship and the effectiveness of every dollar invested.
Designs and executes A/B tests using a rapid test-and-learn approach to continuously optimize ad performance and post-click user engagement.
Proactively contributes to campaign budgets; manages execution against campaign strategies by optimizing spending during campaigns; and reports on results and learnings after campaigns conclude.
User Google Analytics and other reporting tools to ensure user behavior and engagement from marketing efforts is tracked properly and deeply understood behavior beyond ad platform reporting.
Leads foundational SEO research using Semrush or equivalent platforms to identify constituent search demand, search intent, keyword opportunities, competitive search gaps, content opportunities, organic search trends, and areas where existing content can be improved to increase discoverability and engagement.
Leads Answer Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO) research and measurement using AI-search intelligence platforms to understand how Focus on the Family, its ministries, resources, priority topics, and offers are represented across AI answer engines.
Monitors AI-search visibility, share of voice, prompt performance, competitor presence, citations, sentiment, and brand accuracy, and translates findings into recommendations for content development, optimization, digital PR, earned media, and other strategies that improve Focus on the Family's authority and discoverability in AI-generated answers.
Supports the Sr. Dir. Marketing-Guided Digital Engagement by delivering strategic keyword, prompt, audience-intent, competitor, and search-demand insights that inform ministry content strategy and help Focus develop resources around the questions, needs, and topics constituents are actively exploring through both traditional and AI-powered search.
Analyzes the sources and content cited by AI answer engines to identify opportunities for Focus-owned content, earned media, authoritative third-party references, partnerships, and other sources to strengthen Focus on the Family's authority and likelihood of inclusion in AI-generated answers.
Monitors how AI platforms describe Focus on the Family, its ministries, programs, resources, and positions; identifies material inaccuracies or outdated information; and collaborates with appropriate teams to improve the authoritative source information influencing AI-generated responses.
Develops and manages paid search, SEO, and AEO testing strategies to determine which content, technical, citation, messaging, and optimization approaches improve visibility, engagement, user experience, and conversion across traditional and AI-driven discovery channels.
Connects paid search, organic search, and AI-search performance to measurable ministry outcomes, including assessment participation, subscriptions, registrations, lead generation, donations, content engagement, and other priority constituent actions. Provides regular reporting and analysis of paid search, SEO, and AI-search performance to the Sr. Dir. Marketing-Guided Digital Engagement and key ministry stakeholders, explaining not only what changed but the WHY behind the data, implications for constituent behavior, and recommended actions.
Serves as the Ministry Subject Matter Expert (SME) for digital search and discovery, including paid search, SEO, and AI/answer-engine search, maintaining an understanding of how Focus constituents, like audiences, and expanded audiences express needs, ask questions, discover resources, and evaluate solutions across traditional search engines and AI platforms. Uses these insights to help the ministry faithfully steward resources and maximize meaningful constituent engagement.
Manages external partner relationships related to testing and digital marketing initiatives as assigned.

Other Duties/Responsibilities:

Performs other duties as assigned

Managerial Breadth/Scope of Job:

None

Working Environment/Physical Requirements:

Office environment

JOB QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS:

Character/Spiritual:

Exemplifies Ephesians 5:1-2, “Therefore be imitators of God as dear children and walk in love, as Christ also has loved us and given Himself for us...”

Pursues the Great Commission given by Jesus Christ in Matthew 28:19-20, “Go therefore and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all things that I have commanded you; and lo, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”

Is a consistent witness for Jesus Christ; maintains a courteous, Christ-like attitude in dealing with people within and outside of Focus; adheres to the Standard of Moral Conduct and Statement of Faith; upholds Focus on the Family's ministry in prayer

Prays personally for Focus on the Family’s staff and constituents and may occasionally lead in a public prayer

Engages in Christian ministry

Demonstrates behaviors aligned with FOF core values

Personal Characteristics:

Strong oral and written communication; Team player; Highly organized; Results driven
Analytical; Sense of humor

Knowledge/Experience:

5-7 years of experience in digital marketing.
Demonstrated performance in “winning” in particular keyword spaces against primary competitors required.
Google Ads Advanced Certification.
Google Analytics Advanced Certification.
Experience executing and analyzing paid search marketing strategies.
Experience with web analytics tools, particularly Google Analytics.
Demonstrated experience with SEO research platforms such as Semrush, including keyword research, competitor analysis, keyword/content gap analysis, search intent, and organic performance analysis.
Experience with or demonstrated ability to rapidly develop expertise in AI-search/AEO/GEO visibility and optimization platforms, including prompt research, AI visibility measurement, citation analysis, competitive benchmarking, sentiment, and AI brand accuracy monitoring.
Working knowledge of Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI search behavior, and the evolving relationship between traditional search engines and AI answer engines.
Demonstrated experience translating search, audience, competitive, and performance data into actionable recommendations for content, acquisition, and digital engagement strategies.
Working knowledge of FOF mission, philosophy, values, and objectives.

Tula AI Labs is a growing AI agency based in Tampa. We build AI agents into companies, design CRMs and automations, and run marketing for growing businesses with AI. Our clients range from manufacturers to hospitality brands, and our work shows up in their leads, their bookings, and their revenue.

Our mission: Technology should make people more human at work, not less. We build AI workers that take the busywork, so people can do what only people can.

We are small, fast, and building. The person in this seat will help shape how Tula runs marketing for years to come.

Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal.
That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

At Personify Health, we value and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We believe in creating teams made up of individuals with various backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Why? Because diversity inspires innovation, collaboration, and challenges us to produce better solutions. But more than this, diversity is our strength, and a catalyst in our ability to #changelivesforgood.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

Personify Health is a personalized health platform built on a simple idea: healthier lives create healthier businesses. We're entering a year where our story needs to get louder and sharper, and this role is how it happens. You'll set the content strategy, own how the brand shows up across channels, and still write and edit the work that matters most. You lead a small team of brand and social managers, partner closely with product marketing so our company story and our product story sound like one voice, and share ownership of our outside PR agency with the VP of Integrated Marketing.

This is a hands-on director role. You'll spend part of your week building a content plan and part of it fixing a headline.

Content strategy and creation

Build and run the content strategy for our wellbeing and health platform story, tied to the 2027 go-to-market priorities
Personally write and edit high-visibility pieces: executive thought leadership, bylines, key narratives, web and campaign copy
Build editorial calendars and a repeatable content engine that serves sales, marketing, and product
Turn complex health and benefits topics into clear, useful content for HR leaders, benefits buyers, brokers, and consultants

Brand and social leadership

Manage the brand manager and social media manager, setting priorities, giving real feedback, and developing their skills
Keep voice, tone, and visual identity consistent across every channel and partner
Shape an organic social presence that supports pipeline and executive visibility

Product marketing partnership and message continuity

Work hand in hand with product marketing to connect brand-level and division-level messaging to the product story, so a buyer hears the same thing at every stage
Make sure mid-funnel and bottom-of-funnel product content (solution briefs, case studies, sales enablement, demos, and web pages) carries the same narrative, proof points, and tone as top-of-funnel brand content

Marcom and campaign support

By six months: Strong thought leadership and campaign content is flowing, and a buyer sees the same story on our website, in a sales conversation, and in the press.
