jobs.description:
Description

AWS is seeking a Senior Manager to lead the Cross-Category Services marketing team. This role owns the marketing strategy and execution for a portfolio of services that help AWS customers accelerate their cloud transformations and achieve long-term success: AWS Training & Certification, AWS Support, AWS Professional Services, and AWS Marketplace & Partner Services.

These services represent a critical part of the AWS customer journey — from building skills and getting expert guidance, to finding and deploying third-party solutions, to ensuring ongoing operational excellence. Together they generate billions in revenue.

As the leader of this team, you will build and manage a high-performing team of product marketers, develop differentiated positioning and messaging for each portfolio, drive customer insights that inform marketing strategy, and serve as the connective tissue between diverse business stakeholders who have different operating rhythms, go-to-market motions, and customer audiences.

This is a role for someone who thrives in complexity — someone who can context-switch fluidly across businesses while maintaining strategic coherence, who builds trust with senior stakeholders through intellectual rigor and consistent delivery.

Key job responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Execution

Develop and own the marketing strategy for Training & Certification, Support, Professional Services, and Marketplace — including positioning, messaging, value propositions, and go-to-market plans
Synthesize customer insights, market data, and competitive intelligence to identify opportunities and shape strategy across all four businesses
Drive differentiated messaging that connects each service to the broader AWS customer success narrative — helping customers understand how these services accelerate transformation
Lead product launch strategies and associated plans, including naming, target audience definition, content development, and marketing vehicle selection
Continuously measure and optimize marketing performance, establishing KPIs and mechanisms for each portfolio

Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the primary marketing partner to four distinct business leadership teams, each with different operating rhythms, customer segments, and go-to-market motions
Build deep trust with VP and Director-level stakeholders across product, sales, professional services, and partner organizations through intellectual rigor and consistent delivery
Navigate competing priorities and resource constraints across portfolios — making principled trade-off decisions and communicating them transparently

People Management & Team Building

Build, lead, and develop a team of product and general marketing professionals spanning multiple portfolios and locations
Hire, retain, and grow top marketing talent
Resource the team effectively across portfolios, making staffing recommendations aligned to business priority and impact

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

The Strategic Communications Assistant Director of Web Services provides strategic oversight of all web services provided by UMKC’s division of Strategic Marketing and Communications (MCOM). The Opportunity

USAA is looking for an experienced Decision Science Analyst Senior to join the Life Company Data and Analytics team.
USAA Life Company is looking to build on its foundation of exceptional service to grow and serve more members. The essence of work performed by the Decision Science Analyst involves gathering, manipulating and synthesizing data (e.g., attributes, transactions, behaviors, etc.), models and other relevant information to draw conclusions and make recommendations resulting in implementable strategies.

Translates recommendation into communication materials to effectively present to various levels of management.
Incorporates visualization techniques to support the relevant points of the analysis and ease the understanding for less technical audiences.

Integrates/transforms disparate data sources and determines the appropriate data hygiene techniques to apply.
Thoroughly documents assumptions, methodology, validation and testing to facilitate peer reviews and compliance requirements.
Understands and adopts emerging technology that can affect the application of scientific methodologies and/or quantitative analytical approaches to problem resolutions.
Succinctly delivers analysis/findings in a manner that conveys understanding, influences various levels of management, garners support for recommendations, drives business decisions, and influences business strategy.
Provides subject matter expertise in operationalizing recommendations.
Remains informed on current data and analytics trends, (Ex: Cloud, Data Mining, Python, Neural Networks, Sensor data, IoT, Streaming/NRT data).
Identifies opportunities to continue to learn in the data and analytics space, whether informal (e.g., Coursera, Udemy, Kaggle, Code Up, etc.) or formal (e.g. Certifications or advanced coursework).
Ensure risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Sciences, Operations Research, Data and/or Business Analysis, Data Science, or a business or quantitative field OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree. (Total of 10 years of experience without bachelor’s degree)
6 years of data & analytics experience OR a minimum of 4 years of data & analytics experience and up to 2 years of progressive functional business relevant experience within the respective industry of responsibility (i.e. Life Insurance, Marketing etc.) for a total of 6 years combined experience OR Advanced degree in quantitative analytics field such as Economics, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Sciences, Operations Research, Data and/or Business Analysis, Data Science or other quantitative discipline and 4 years of experience in data/analytics or functional business experience within the respective industry of responsibility (i.e. Life Insurance, Marketing, etc.).
Demonstrates advanced skills in mathematical and statistical techniques and approaches used to drive fact-based decision-making.
Advanced knowledge of data analysis tools, data visualization, developing analysis queries and procedures in SQL, SAS, BI tools or other analysis software, and relevant industry data & methods and ability to connect external insights to business problems.
Experience with new and emerging data sets, and incorporation (data wrangling, data munging) into new insights.

What Sets You Apart

US military experience through military service or a military spouse/domestic partner.
5+ years of experience using SQL and Python to analyze data, develop insights, and support marketing decision-making.
3+ years of experience optimizing paid social campaigns through audience targeting, bidding strategies, budget management, retargeting, and performance analysis.

Description

Position Title:

Social Media Coordinator-HSO Digital and Social Media-Mount Sinai Hospital-Hybrid-Full Time-Days

Position Summary

The Digital and Social Media Coordinator is responsible for executing the Mount Sinai Health System’s social media strategy across key channels—including Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, X, Facebook, and Threads. The successful candidate will work closely with key members of the Social Media Department to translate complex medical and research concepts into clear, compelling social media content. This role will be instrumental in expanding our digital audience and increasing our overall brand presence.

Responsibilities

Conceptualize, write, and produce daily multi-platform content across primary channels for both the Mount Sinai Health System and the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai, translating complex clinical data, medical research breakthroughs, and academic achievements into accessible, engaging public health communications.
Produce short-form vertical video content (e.g., Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) highlighting patient stories, clinical innovations, student/faculty spotlights, and research milestones.
Actively monitor brand mentions, patient inquiries, and trending medical/academic discussions to foster positive community engagement while strictly adhering to HIPAA and institutional privacy guidelines.
Working with other members of the team, track, analyze, and report on key metrics across both health system and medical school channels to refine overall strategy.
Utilize current social media best practices, platform feature updates, and modern workflow/AI tools (e.g., caption generation, asset optimization) to increase execution efficiency without sacrificing accuracy.
Partner closely with internal communications, research teams, marketing, and academic departments to align social media campaigns with broader institutional goals.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education Requirements:

Bachelors degree or greater preferred, or combination of applicable experience and education

Experience Requirements

2-3+ years’ experience in social media marketing required; preferably in social media content production, graphic design, presentation design, and analytics.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Excellent project management and organizational skills.
Knowledge of social media platforms, trends and best practices.
Experience with social media management tools and analytic platforms.
Ability to supervise and train employees, to include organizing, scheduling work assignments.
Experience working with multiple stakeholders; client service oriented with ability to partner with stakeholders toward solutions.
Collaborative, strong communicator and listener with sensitivity to multiple styles and perspectives; able to build and foster strong relationships with diverse constituencies.
Ability to work independently, shift gears quickly when needed, and hit tight deadlines while valuing collaboration and working with others to accomplish goals.
Creative thinker with experience in providing new and different ways to solve for problems and opportunities.
Strong character, intelligence, integrity, common sense, and dedication to the mission of Mount Sinai Health System.

REPORTS TO: Vice President, Marketing and Communications

Position Summary

The Special Olympics Ohio (SOOH) Senior Manager, Marketing and Communications will report directly to the Vice President, Marketing and Communications. This position will help lead the planning and execution of integrated marketing and communications strategies that increase awareness, strengthen statewide engagement, and promote the mission, programs, athletes, and events of Special Olympics Ohio.

The Senior Manager will serve as a hands-on leader across storytelling, digital marketing, social media, media relations, brand management, website content, internal communications, and performance measurement. The role will work collaboratively across departments and regions to translate organizational priorities into clear, compelling, and measurable communications.

Essential Job Functions

(Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.)

Partner with the Vice President to develop and implement annual marketing and communications strategies, campaigns, calendars, goals, and performance measures.

Strategic Communications & Marketing

Support development and execution of statewide marketing and communications initiatives.
Manage annual communications calendars aligned with organizational priorities and major events.
Develop integrated campaigns that increase awareness, engagement, participation, volunteerism, and support.
Partner with departments across the organization to identify strategic communication opportunities.
Ensure messaging consistency across all channels and audiences.

Storytelling & Content Strategy

·       Lead development and management of a statewide storytelling program.

·       Identify and capture compelling athlete, volunteer, coach, family, donor, and partner stories.

·       Create / Develop content for digital, print, email, video, social media, and earned media channels.

·       Manage editorial planning and content calendars.

·       Maintain and grow a library of mission-focused content assets.

Digital Marketing & Social Media

Oversee day-to-day management of social media platforms and digital campaigns.
Develop and execute content strategies that increase engagement and audience growth.
Support website content management and optimization.
Monitor digital performance and recommend improvements based on analytics.
Identify emerging digital trends and opportunities for audience growth.

Media Relations & Public Relations

Build and maintain relationships with media outlets across Ohio.
Develop media pitches, press releases, talking points, and media kits.
Coordinate earned media opportunities surrounding major events, campaigns, and athlete stories.
Track and report on media coverage and public relations outcomes.
Support spokesperson preparation and media interview coordination.

Brand Management

Ensure compliance with organizational brand standards and guidelines.
Develop communication toolkits, templates, and messaging resources.
Provide consultation and communications support to regional teams and community based programs.
Assist in maintaining a consistent voice and visual identity across channels.

Internal Communications

Support internal communication initiatives that enhance alignment and engagement.
Develop content for staff, volunteers, board members, and organizational stakeholders.
Assist with communication planning for organizational announcements and initiatives.
Contribute to efforts that improve communication flow across departments and regions.

Analytics & Performance Measurement

Monitor and analyze marketing and communications performance metrics.
Prepare regular performance reports and dashboards.
Track media coverage, website performance, social engagement, email effectiveness, and campaign outcomes.
Use data and audience insights to inform future communications strategies.

Required Qualifications, Experience & Skills

·   Bachelor's degree in communications, marketing, public relations, journalism, graphic design, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

·   Five to seven years of progressively responsible experience in marketing, communications, public relations, digital marketing, or a related field; nonprofit or mission-driven experience preferred.

·   Demonstrated ability to translate organizational goals into integrated communications plans, campaigns, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

·   Exceptional writing, editing, interviewing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to adapt content for different audiences and channels.

·   Experience managing social media platforms, digital content, email marketing, website content, and communications calendars.

·   Working knowledge of media relations, including pitching, press material development, interview coordination, and coverage tracking.

·   Strong project management skills and the ability to prioritize multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and maintain exceptional attention to detail.

·   Proficiency with Microsoft Office products and experience with content creation, design, publishing, analytics, and project-management tools; Canva and Adobe experience preferred.

·   Experience with photography, videography, short-form video, or creative vendor management preferred.

·   Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, take initiative, and collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders at varying levels of seniority.

·   High energy and passion for the Special Olympics mission, inclusion, and athlete-centered storytelling.

·   Excellent written, oral, interpersonal, and receptive communication skills.

·   Must be willing to travel independently to support periodic events throughout the state.

·   Must be comfortable behind a camera for photography and videography initiatives.

Miscellaneous Information

·   Position is full-time, exempt.

·   Days/hours of work: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

·   Evening and weekend work is required as position demands and may at times be extensive.

·   Independent in-state travel is required, including independent overnight and weekend travel as an essential function of the position.

·   Required to maintain and provide proof of a valid, current state driver’s license and automobile property and casualty insurance at all times.

Other Duties

jobs.title: Senior Demand Generation Manager
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus

jobs.title: Senior Brand Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Ghirardelli, we honor tradition and drive innovation, aiming to be the top choice for premium chocolate. Our commitment to Making Life A Bite Better inspires both our products and the way we do business. We support personal and professional growth, recognizing that each employee’s contribution directly impacts Ghirardelli’s growth and success. Join our dynamic team and help shape Ghirardelli's future.

Job Summary

WHO WE ARE

Established in San Francisco since 1852, Ghirardelli has spent generations perfecting the craft of premium chocolate. From responsible sourcing to time-honored roasting and processing techniques, we honor the tradition of our iconic brand as we innovate and grow the business. We are fueled by a spirit of entrepreneurship and innovation, and that same passion shapes our workplace, where people are genuinely welcomed, supported, and encouraged to grow. If you’re excited to join our welcoming and vibrant team that celebrates creativity, collaboration, and delicious possibilities, you'll feel right at home with us.

The Senior Brand Manager
is responsible for leading the development and execution plans for the assigned brand, as part of the long-term marketing strategy. The Brand Manager will collaborate cross-functionally to drive profitable, equity-building brand growth.

Responsibilities And Duties

Portfolio Management

Responsible for managing an assigned portfolio to hit revenue and profit targets, to include SKU rationalization, mix strategies and profit optimization.
Develop product portfolio strategy and 3 Year Innovation Pipeline, exploring areas such as format, packaging, and recipe extensions and adjacencies.
Lead the cross functional team in the new product development process.
Lead the go-to-market process for product innovation, including marketing plans, selling tools, and forecasting volume and growth expectations.

Marketing Strategy & Execution

Develop annual marketing plans for alignment with senior stakeholders. Present and defend plans to executive leadership.
Develop, execute and evaluate marketing programs (advertising and consumer promotions) that are based on consumer, customer and competitive trends.
Manage product portfolio budget, including preparing and tracking annual P&L.
Lead delivery of clear and inspiring annual marketing plans to sales organization.
Collaborate with customer marketing and sales to define and deliver customer specific programs.
Manage the creative development process with internal teams and external agencies from briefing through critical feedback to execution
Prepare and present annual business review for executive leadership.
Attend sales calls and participate in selling at the customer level.
Identify research needs to inform decision making and conduct research in collaboration with Insights Manager

Management & Leadership

Provide business and team leadership in a fast-paced environment.
Set individual and team objectives, plan project steps and resources needed, and manage execution.
Train and develop direct reports for promotion and individual growth.
Hire, develop and manage performance of team. Create an inclusive environment that embraces our values and purpose.

Minumum Education And Experience

jobs.title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager, GTM
jobs.description:
ABOUT OBLQ

OBLQ builds software for independent insurance agencies, providing technology solutions that help independent P&Cs operate more efficiently and grow faster. We handle the technology so agencies can focus on selling policies and driving revenue. Learn more at oblq.ai.

Same Team. More Agency.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help turn our products that deliver for existing customers into a company and category that independent insurance agencies know about, understand, and want to buy.

You'll work directly with the founders and stay close to both the product and our customers. You'll learn how independent agencies operate, what slows their teams down, why they buy, what makes them skeptical, and how OBLQ changes the economics of their business. Then you'll turn those insights into the way we go to market.

You'll own product positioning, messaging, launches, customer stories, sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and much of the content that connects OBLQ to the market.

This is an early-stage role. We have products our customers love, we have great data and measurable results, a brand, and a point of view. We need someone who can take those raw materials and build a repeatable product marketing engine around them.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Position OBLQ and its products.
Develop clear positioning and messaging for OBLQs current and future products. Understand what matters to agency owners & agents, and translate complex product capabilities into simple reasons to care.

Own the product story.
Make sure our website, social presence, sales materials, demos, campaigns, and product launches tell a consistent and compelling story.

Know the customer.
Spend time with independent agency owners and agents. Understand how they generate leads, quote business, work with carriers, use their CRM, follow up with customers, and make technology decisions.

Turn customer outcomes into proof.
Build case studies, customer stories, ROI narratives, testimonials, and other evidence that helps prospective customers understand what OBLQ can do for their agency.

Build sales enablement.
Give the people selling OBLQ what they need to have better conversations: messaging, presentations, one-pagers, competitive positioning, objection handling, demo narratives, follow-up materials, and customer-specific stories.

Own product launches.
Create the go-to-market plan for new capabilities, carrier integrations, product releases, and future OBLQ products. Define the audience, message, channels, assets, and measures of success.

Understand the market.
Know the insurance technology landscape, the alternatives agencies use today, and where OBLQ fits. Track competitors, comparative raters, agency management systems, CRMs, automation products, and emerging technologies that could change the market.

Build content that earns attention.
Create and manage content for the channels where our customers spend time. That may include LinkedIn, customer email, website content, product education, thought leadership, webinars, industry communities, and other formats we discover work.

Improve how we generate demand.
Work across organic, outbound, partnerships, referrals, and paid acquisition to understand which messages and channels create qualified interest. Test quickly, measure results, and keep what works.

Bring the market back into the product.
You won't own the product roadmap, but you'll have an important voice in it. Bring customer feedback, competitive intelligence, win/loss insights, and market signals back into product decisions.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have experience marketing B2B software products and can show examples where your work changed how a product was understood, sold, adopted, or launched.

You know how to find the useful insight inside a customer conversation and turn it into positioning or messaging people actually understand.

You can explain a complicated product simply without stripping away what makes it valuable.

You understand the difference between describing a feature and explaining why someone should care about it.

You're comfortable creating the strategy and doing the work. At this stage, you may define the launch plan in the morning and write the landing page in the afternoon.

You can work closely with product and engineering teams and become technically fluent enough to market what we're building accurately.

You use data to evaluate your work. You care about pipeline, conversion, engagement, adoption, and revenue more than impressions for their own sake.

You're comfortable operating with incomplete information and creating structure where it doesn't yet exist.

You have strong judgment about brand and messaging. You know when something needs another round of thinking and when it just needs to get into the market so we can learn.

SKILLS WE'RE INTERESTED IN

Working with AI tools to accelerate research, content, experimentation, and execution
B2B SaaS or vertical SaaS
Insurance or insurtech (nice to have)
Products sold to small and midsize businesses
Workflow automation or operational software
Product-led or founder-led companies moving toward a repeatable GTM model
Sales enablement and customer storytelling
Launching new or unfamiliar product categories
Competitive and market research
Demand generation and lifecycle marketing

Insurance experience is not a prerequisite. We care more about your ability to understand a market quickly and turn what you learn into effective product marketing.

HOW WE WORK

Our development cycle is fast. New capabilities can move from idea to working software quickly, which means product marketing needs to stay equally close to the product and the customer.

We value people who understand the problem, form a point of view, communicate it clearly, put it into the market, measure what happens, and improve it.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

A year from now:
An independent agency owner can land on OBLQ and quickly understand what we do, why it's different, and why it matters to their business.
Our positioning and messaging are consistent everywhere a prospect encounters us.
Customer outcomes have become credible stories, proof points, and sales assets.
Product launches have an audience, message, plan, and measurement strategy before they ship.
Sales conversations are supported by strong materials and a clear understanding of customer objections and competitive alternatives.
We know which messages, audiences, and channels create qualified opportunities and we're investing more heavily in the ones that work.
What we're learning in the market is consistently making its way back into the product.
Our product marketing capability is repeatable and can scale with the company.

jobs.description:
Description

Team: RamseyTrusted - Real Estate & Tax

Please note that applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Location: Franklin, TN—on-site, relocation assistance available, flexible schedules available

A Little Bit About Us: You might know us from our founder and CEO, Dave Ramsey, who's given no-nonsense money advice on the radio since 1992. Three decades later, Ramsey Solutions is a household name in personal finance, with a mission to change the toxic money culture for good.

Our Mission: Ramsey Solutions provides biblically based, commonsense education and empowerment that give HOPE to everyone in every walk of life.

Here's a Taste Of Our Benefits

Health insurance (includes plans eligible for an HSA—with a company match up to $500!)
401(k) retirement plan with 4% match/company contribution
Annual wellness, counseling and grocery membership reimbursement
On-campus cafe with subsidized pricing for breakfast, lunch and coffee bar
Dependent care FSA
Tons of cultural activities, like weekly devotional, leadership development courses, Battle of the Bands, and one epic Christmas party!

Where And How You'd Work

Ramsey Solutions Headquarters is located just outside of Nashville in Franklin, Tennessee. We value our strong, unified company culture because we believe the best work is done together. That's why all of our team members work on-site under the same roof. But work-life balance is also important to us, so we offer flexible work schedules to take the stress out of appointments, family obligations and other needs that may pop up.

While every team member has a designated workspace (with an electronic sit-stand desk), our campus was designed to house a variety of unique work and play zones (e.g., quiet library space, coffee bar/lounge areas, recreational game zone, and outside/patio work and break areas).

What You'd Do In This Role

Copy that moves people to act is rare, and this role produces it. You'll own the writing for a close-knit marketing squad that helps people find trusted experts who serve them well, crafting short-form pieces like emails, landing pages, paid ads, video scripts, and podcast promotions. You'll build campaigns alongside marketers, designers, and paid media specialists, test what works, and sharpen your craft with performance data. The work matters because the mission does: every message you write guides someone toward the right help at the right time.

You're Probably a Match If

You have 3+ years of professional experience writing marketing and advertising copy yourself, and a portfolio of short-form work to show for it.
You write in a conversational, human voice and can flex your style across audiences, channels, and campaign types.
You've written across paid and organic media, social, email, landing pages, and video scripts.
Your copy drives measurable outcomes like engagement, conversions, and revenue.
You use AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude in your writing workflow and can share real examples of how.
You thrive in a collaborative, cross-functional squad, give and receive feedback well, and don't shy away from healthy conflict.
You start every project by understanding the business goal, not just the brief.

What Winning Looks Like

Writing brand-aligned copy that captures Ramsey's voice, strikes the right emotion, and moves people to take the next step.
Partnering with marketing and paid media teammates to optimize copy based on performance data.
Studying customer pain points, marketing journeys, and competitors so every project starts with a clear "why."
Using AI to generate fresh ideas and check work against brand standards while keeping the thinking firmly your own.
Holding your work with an open hand, welcoming feedback, and carrying what you learn from one project to the next.
Contributing to a squad culture of shared ownership by collaborating openly, engaging in healthy conflict, and showing up as a trusted teammate.

Other Stuff To Know

We're looking for people who are passionate about our mission. This isn't just a J-O-B. We experience resistance every day because what we believe is absolutely countercultural. We actually hate debt. We actually cut up our credit cards . . . like, for real. Some of us are still fighting our way out of debt, but we aren't going back. If you don't know much about Ramsey Solutions and our founder, Dave Ramsey, we encourage you to download the Ramsey Network mobile app and consume our content.

If Ramsey Solutions sounds like a workplace where you can get excited about Mondays, apply today. We can't wait to hear from you!

jobs.title: Business Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Marketing Lead based in the United States.

Join a fast-growing blockchain ecosystem working to expand the adoption of decentralized technology across businesses and financial markets. As Business Marketing Lead, you will turn strategic partnerships, integrations, and commercial deployments into compelling stories that demonstrate the value of building on a high-performance blockchain network. You will lead collaborative go-to-market initiatives with crypto-native companies, financial institutions, fintechs, and technology partners. Working across business development, go-to-market, content, and creative teams, you will develop campaigns that strengthen market awareness and showcase real-world adoption. From messaging and case studies to launch activations, you will own campaigns from initial brief through execution and performance measurement. This remote opportunity is ideal for a strategic, highly organized marketer who combines excellent storytelling skills with strong execution and a passion for blockchain innovation.

Accountabilities

In this role, you will lead partner marketing initiatives that translate business relationships and technical integrations into impactful campaigns and market-facing content. Your responsibilities will include:

Go-to-Market Collaboration: Work closely with business development, go-to-market, and content teams to understand pipeline priorities, identify partnership opportunities, and determine where collaborative marketing can generate the greatest impact.
Campaign Strategy and Prioritization: Maintain visibility into upcoming integrations, deployments, and launches. Evaluate opportunities based on potential impact, determine the appropriate level of marketing support, and develop clear campaign strategies.
Partner Marketing Campaigns: Design and lead joint marketing initiatives with key ecosystem partners, translating integrations and commercial relationships into compelling narratives that demonstrate adoption, capabilities, and momentum.
Content Development and Storytelling: Create and oversee social media activations, case studies, blog posts, messaging, and other creative assets that communicate the value of building on the network to business and technical audiences.
End-to-End Campaign Execution: Manage campaigns from initial briefs through launch and follow-up, coordinating timelines, creative deliverables, stakeholder alignment, legal and compliance reviews, and launch sequencing.
External Stakeholder Management: Collaborate directly with partner marketing and business teams to understand their objectives, identify strong storytelling opportunities, and deliver high-quality joint campaigns.
Campaign Measurement and Optimization: Define campaign objectives and success metrics upfront, monitor performance, evaluate outcomes, and use insights to improve future marketing initiatives.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Work across internal go-to-market and creative teams to ensure campaign priorities, messaging, and deliverables are aligned with broader business objectives.
Operational Excellence: Manage multiple complex workstreams simultaneously, maintain high standards of quality, and use AI tools and automation to improve efficiency and execution.

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines business or partner marketing expertise with strong storytelling abilities, sound judgment, and a deep understanding of the blockchain ecosystem. You should be comfortable working autonomously, managing complex external relationships, and translating technical or commercial concepts into compelling marketing campaigns. Key qualifications include:

At least 5 years of experience in business marketing, partner marketing, or a related field, ideally within crypto, financial services, or enterprise technology.
A solid understanding of the cryptocurrency and blockchain ecosystem, with the ability to communicate credibly with both crypto-native organizations and traditional businesses.
Familiarity with decentralized finance (DeFi), payments, stablecoins, tokenization, or financial infrastructure is a strong advantage.
Demonstrated experience owning integrated marketing or joint go-to-market campaigns involving external partners, from initial planning through launch and performance measurement.
Excellent writing and editing skills, including the ability to understand complex integrations or business relationships and translate them into clear, persuasive stories for sophisticated audiences.
Strong strategic judgment and the ability to identify the most compelling market-facing narratives and prioritize opportunities according to business impact.
Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple concurrent campaigns, manage timelines, and maintain high-quality deliverables.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience collaborating with external marketing teams and internal cross-functional partners.
A proactive, self-directed approach, with the ability to take ownership, make informed decisions, and move projects forward with minimal oversight.
Familiarity with AI tools and automation, including the ability to use them thoughtfully to improve marketing workflows and productivity.
Adaptability and a collaborative mindset suited to a lean, ambitious team that values initiative, low-ego teamwork, and high-quality output.

Benefits

Remote work: Full-time remote opportunity.
Meaningful impact: Help expand blockchain adoption by showcasing real-world business applications and strategic integrations.
Complex and challenging work: Tackle technically demanding marketing challenges at the intersection of decentralized technology, financial infrastructure, and enterprise adoption.
Autonomy and ownership: Lead campaigns from concept to execution, with the opportunity to shape partner marketing strategy and deliver measurable results.
Collaborative team environment: Work with a highly motivated team that values collaboration, initiative, and high-quality work.
Ecosystem exposure: Engage with a growing network of investors, builders, businesses, and long-term contributors across the blockchain industry.
Professional growth: Develop expertise in business marketing, strategic partnerships, and go-to-market initiatives within an evolving technology ecosystem.

Always Build Trust

Never Stop Growing
- Change IS the constant. Stay hungry and curious. Be relentless in the pursuit of progress

Find a way
- Never settle, no excuses, nothing is impossible. Just make it happen

Our values guide us, and our mission drives us. Come join us and help deliver financial wellness for the whole family, putting the tools of wealth-making into everyone’s hands.

____________________________________________________________

Growth Marketing, Sr. Associate - New Channels | Acorns

Acorns is looking for a curious, driven Growth Marketing Sr. Associate to join our team and help expand our paid acquisition channel mix. You will work closely with the Senior Paid Acquisition Manager to research, launch, and scale emerging platforms—from programmatic DSPs to community-based channels like Reddit—driving user growth across Acorns and Acorns Early.

This role carries real ownership. You’ll operate with meaningful day-to-day autonomy, exercise judgment within established frameworks, and produce analysis and recommendations that shape how we invest in new channels. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Analytics, Creative, and channel partners to bring experiments to life and move quickly from proof of concept to scaled channel.

Acorns is a remote-first organization
, offering the flexibility to work remotely while providing optional access to office space in Irvine, CA.

What You Will Do

Channel Testing & Execution

Help develop and execute a structured testing roadmap for new and emerging paid media channels, including programmatic display, Reddit, Snapchat, and other alternative platforms.
Own day-to-day campaign management across existing channels like Meta, TikTok, Snap, Reddit, and YouTube
Run tests on new channels, including setup, trafficking, pacing, and ongoing optimization.
Use performance data and judgment to make in-channel optimizations, escalating broader strategic decisions to the Senior Paid Acquisition Manager as needed.
Partner with the Creative team to brief, test, and iterate on ad assets tailored to each platform and audience.

Measurement & Reporting

Identify incrementality and lift study opportunities, collaborate with the Analytics team to design the test structure, and own the launch and ongoing performance monitoring of each experiment.
Track and report on key performance indicators for new and existing channel initiatives, translating data into clear summaries for internal stakeholders.
Maintain organized records of test results, learnings, and optimization actions to build a shared knowledge base for the team.

Cross-Brand & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Support acquisition growth across our brand portfolio—Acorns and Acorns Early.
Work collaboratively with Analytics, Creative, and other marketing teammates to execute experiments efficiently and surface actionable insights.
Actively monitor the AdTech landscape—including gaming platforms (e.g., Roblox, Discord), community platforms, and emerging programmatic DSPs—and bring forward channel opportunities for the team to evaluate.

What You Will Bring

3+ years of experience in performance marketing, paid media, or growth marketing with a BS/BA; or equivalent work experience.
Hands-on experience with at least one paid media platform (e.g., Meta, Snapchat, Reddit, The Trade Desk, or similar).

Job title:
Head of Marketing (Creator Economy)
Company:
HotDrop
Workplace type:
Remote

About HotDrop

HotDrop is a social platform built for the creator economy. Creators use it to keep their communities together, show their work and connect with each other. Fans use it to stay close to the creators they support.

Every creator gets a Circle, a home for their community that connects to their Twitch and YouTube. Around it, HotDrop gives creators a feed, stories, messaging, and a Site and media kit they can share with brands and collaborators. HotDrop is live on iOS, Android and the web, with Reels and a desktop app coming by the end of the year.

The product is built. What HotDrop needs now is someone who knows how to get creators and their communities to show up, and to keep coming back.

The role

You’ll own HotDrop’s marketing from day one: the strategy, the voice and the hands-on work. This isn’t a role where you hand things off to an agency or a team. You’ll run our social channels yourself, shape how we pitch HotDrop to creators and fans, and lead our launches.

You’ll work directly with the founder and our Head of Creator Growth. They bring creators onto the platform; you make sure those creators’ audiences hear about HotDrop, want to join and have a reason to stay.

What you’ll do

Social and content
Run HotDrop’s social accounts day to day, including X, TikTok, Instagram and YouTube
Turn what’s happening on HotDrop (creators, communities, moments, milestones) into content people want to share
Build a consistent HotDrop voice and look across every channel

Launches
Own our launches, starting with Reels and our desktop app later this year
Line up creators before each launch, seed the content and drive the launch itself
Plan campaigns that bring past users back when there’s something new to see

Creators and their communities
Help creators invite their audiences into their HotDrop Circles: what they say on stream, what they post in their Discord and on social, and when
Write the playbooks and assets that make inviting easy for creators: templates, clips, graphics and talking points
Work with our Head of Creator Growth on our creator programs

Positioning
Sharpen how we explain HotDrop to creators and to fans
Keep our website, emails, app store pages and social posts telling the same story
Shape and promote the HotDrop Twitch show with the founder

Measurement
Track what brings people in and what keeps them coming back
Double down on what works and cut what doesn’t, quickly

What success looks like

More new people arriving each week, and more of them staying. Within your first 90 days, you’ll have:

Taken over HotDrop’s social channels and set a regular posting rhythm
Shipped a creator invite playbook our pilot creators actually use
Led at least one launch from planning through results
Set up a simple weekly view of what’s bringing people in and what’s keeping them

What we’re looking for

You’ve grown an audience or a community yourself, whether a channel, a brand account or a creator’s following, and you can show the results
You know the creator economy from the inside. You understand how streamers, YouTubers, mods and fans think, and what makes a creator promote something to their audience
You’ve done hands-on social and growth work, not just strategy
You write well and fast, and you can make short-form video and graphics or get them made

jobs.title: Social Media Strategist, Investing and Tax
jobs.description:
Description

Team:
Marketing

Please note that applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Location:
Franklin, TN—on-site, relocation assistance available, flexible schedules available

Salary:
$66,000–$78,000/year* + profit sharing + benefits

Range depends on skill level and overall experience.

A Little Bit About Us:
You might know us from our founder and CEO, Dave Ramsey, who's given no-nonsense money advice on the radio since 1992. Three decades later, Ramsey Solutions is a household name in personal finance, with a mission to change the toxic money culture for good.

Our Mission: Ramsey Solutions provides biblically based, commonsense education and empowerment that give HOPE to everyone in every walk of life.

Here's a Taste Of Our Benefits

Health insurance (includes plans eligible for an HSA—with a company match up to $500!)
401(k) retirement plan with 4% match/company contribution
Annual wellness, counseling and grocery membership reimbursement
On-campus cafe with subsidized pricing for breakfast, lunch and coffee bar
Dependent care FSA
Tons of cultural activities, like weekly devotional, leadership development courses, Battle of the Bands, and one epic Christmas party!

Where And How You'd Work

Ramsey Solutions Headquarters is located just outside of Nashville in Franklin, Tennessee. We value our strong, unified company culture because we believe the best work is done together. That's why all of our team members work on-site under the same roof. But work-life balance is also important to us, so we offer flexible work schedules to take the stress out of appointments, family obligations and other needs that may pop up.

While every team member has a designated workspace (with an electronic sit-stand desk), our campus was designed to house a variety of unique work and play zones (e.g., quiet library space, coffee bar/lounge areas, recreational game zone, and outside/patio work and break areas).

What You'd Do In This Role

Ramsey's investing content reaches millions of people trying to build wealth the right way, and this role owns turning that message into content that stops the scroll. You'll set the strategy, content calendar, and publishing standards across Instagram, Facebook, X, and TikTok, spotting the moments worth turning into a clip and shaping the hooks, formats, and cadence that move people from casual followers to loyal fans of the brand. You'll dig into the numbers, impressions, engagement, and retention, and use what you find to sharpen the strategy in real time. And you'll be a steady hand for the Video Editors you brief, giving them clear direction so the content that goes out consistently sounds and feels like Ramsey.

You're Probably a Match If

You've grown business-focused social accounts and know how to turn content into real audience growth, not just likes.
You think like a strategist, someone who owns the plan, reads the audience, and makes intentional calls, rather than just posting content.
You've got 2+ years of experience building and growing social accounts, with a track record of content that connects with an audience.
You're comfortable in the numbers, digging into platform analytics and turning what you find into a clear next move.
You can talk about money and investing in a way that feels warm, approachable, and easy to follow, never intimidating.
You represent the brand's voice and Ramsey's investing principles clearly and consistently.
You're a self-starter who brings ideas to the table and moves things forward without needing a lot of direction.

What Winning Looks Like

Growing engagement across platforms in a way that reflects a clear, consistent content strategy, not just more posts.
Moving people from casual followers on third-party platforms to loyal fans of Ramsey's owned channels.
Turning platform data into next steps, testing new ideas quickly, and adjusting course based on results.
Building a steady rhythm for sharing insights and recommendations with stakeholders so decisions get made with the numbers in hand.
Staying ahead of platform and industry trends and explaining clearly why they matter for the strategy.
Giving Video Editors clear direction and feedback that makes their work stronger and keeps the content on brand.
Owning the final call on content decisions while staying genuinely open to input along the way.

Other Stuff To Know

We're looking for people who are passionate about our mission. This isn't just a J-O-B. We experience resistance every day because what we believe is absolutely countercultural. We actually hate debt. We actually cut up our credit cards . . . like, for real. Some of us are still fighting our way out of debt, but we aren't going back. If you don't know much about Ramsey Solutions and our founder, Dave Ramsey, we encourage you to download the Ramsey Network mobile app and consume our content.

If Ramsey Solutions sounds like a workplace where you can get excited about Mondays, apply today. We can't wait to hear from you!

jobs.description:
Marketing and Social Media Manager

Gentera Center for Precision Medicine | Coral Gables, FL | Full-time, on-site

About Gentera

Gentera Center for Precision Medicine is a physician-led practice in Coral Gables offering precision, regenerative, and preventive medicine. Our concierge model provides personalized, ongoing care and direct access to physicians. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a marketing leader to help expand our brand and reach.

Position Summary

The Marketing and Social Media Manager leads GMED’s marketing strategy and brings the Gentera brand to life across all channels. This role oversees social media, campaigns, and creative partners while collaborating with providers, sales, and patient experience teams. The ideal candidate is creative, hands-on, comfortable on camera, and skilled at turning ideas into engaging content that drives growth.

Reporting and Collaboration

Reports to:
Chief Strategy and Operating Officer
Oversees:
Digital marketing team, graphic designer, and web developer
Collaborates with:
Providers, sales, patient experience, and leadership

What You’ll Do

Marketing Strategy and Campaigns

Develop and execute marketing campaigns across social media, email, paid advertising, website, and events.
Plan promotions and launches for memberships, services, and new programs.
Manage the marketing budget, content calendar and project timelines.
Coordinate creative partners, CRM automations and integrations.
Maintain consistent branding across all channels.

Social Media and Content

Manage social media from planning and filming to editing, publishing, and engagement.
Create and schedule video, photo, captions, emails, and newsletter content.
Film in the clinic, feature providers, and attend events as a brand representative.
Create educational content that builds trust in our services.
Respond to comments and messages, directing inquiries to the sales team promptly.

Sales, Partnerships and Events

Partner with sales to generate leads and grow memberships and services.
Turn patient questions and feedback into relevant content and campaigns.
Develop collaborations with local businesses, wellness and luxury brands, and creators.
Plan and promote clinic, partner, and community events.

Reporting and Growth

Track marketing performance, share monthly results, and recommend improvements.
Monitor industry trends and bring new ideas to the team.

What We’re Looking For

4+ years of marketing experience, particularly in digital marketing and social media.
Hands-on video filming, editing, and publishing skills using CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Canva, or similar tools.
Experience managing campaigns across social media, email, and paid advertising.
Ability to coordinate designers, agencies and creative teams.
Strong writing skills, creativity and attention to detail.

Organized, collaborative, and skilled at managing multiple projects.
Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

jobs.title: Director, Demand Generation: Public Sector & Expanding Markets
jobs.description:
A Note On How To Reach Us

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Where You’ll Work

As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.

What You’ll Do

Demand generation strategy & execution

Own and execute the demand generation strategy for our government and public sector segment, plus other new segments, building lists, driving MQLs and creating pipeline that consistently meets or exceeds targets
Build and run integrated, multi-channel campaigns (email, paid, events, content) tailored to segment buyer behavior and budget cycles
Bring an inventive, test-and-learn approach, piloting new channels and tactics rather than relying solely on established playbooks

Account-based marketing

Lead ABM strategy and execution for targeted accounts, including account selection, personalization at scale, and close alignment with Sales on account engagement
Partner with Sales to define and refine target account lists across assigned segments including local and state government prospects

Cross-functional partnership

Work closely with Content, Product Marketing, and Sales to ensure messaging and campaigns resonate with buyer pain points
Partner with Events on segment-focused field and virtual events, from conference presence to webinars and roundtable lunch and learns
Align with Sales and RevOps on lead scoring, channel metrics, and handoff to ensure marketing-sourced conversions

Metrics & reporting

Take a highly metrics-driven approach to pipeline generation, with fluency in attribution, funnel conversion, and pipeline efficiency reporting
Report regularly on segment performance against pipeline and revenue targets, adjusting strategy based on results
Other duties as assigned

What You’ll Need

Proven track record leading demand generation through a period of rapid company growth, ideally including experience operating through M&A or platform/product integration
History of consistently meeting or exceeding pipeline and revenue targets at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company
Strong command of account-based marketing (ABM) strategy and execution
Experience marketing B2B SaaS into government buyers, particularly at the local and state level
Highly metrics-driven, with fluency in attribution and funnel/pipeline reporting
Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building process from the ground up as a segment scales
Strong collaborator — experience working closely with Content, Product Marketing, Events, and Sales/RevOps to drive integrated demand generation
Must be legally eligible to work in the United States

Nice to have

Experience in adjacent regulated or mission-driven verticals (nonprofit, education, public sector tech)
Experience with grant management or grantmaking software, or adjacent nonprofit tech
Experience in demand generation at a rapidly growing government focused B2B SaaS company
Familiarity with public sector procurement processes, budget cycles, and messaging tailored to government stakeholders at the local and state level particularly
Relationships within government and public sector networks and associations relevant to grantmaking

What You’ll Bring To Our Team Dynamics

Strategic Thinking

Translates Foundant's North Star into a concrete strategy for scaling into government, public sector, and other emerging segments — building the playbook, list, and pipeline from scratch rather than inheriting an existing one

Performance Advancement

Sets a high bar for pipeline and revenue performance in a brand-new segment, using attribution and funnel data to catch what's working — and what isn't — before quarterly targets are at risk

Decision-Making

Uses evidence and a test-and-learn approach to make fast, well-reasoned calls on new channels and tactics in a segment with no existing playbook to fall back on

Collaboration and Learning

Builds real working relationships across Content, Product Marketing, Events, Sales, and RevOps — because a segment this new only scales if the whole team is pulling in the same direction

Why You’ll Love Working At Foundant

At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well-being and professional success.
We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.

We are seeking an experienced Social Media Marketing Manager to lead social media strategy, content creation, and audience growth for a leading blockchain ecosystem. In this high-impact role, you will shape the brand's digital presence, manage multiple social accounts, and develop engaging content that connects with global Web3 communities. You will transform complex technical concepts, product updates, and campaign narratives into compelling, platform-native stories that drive engagement and adoption. Working closely with leadership and cross-functional teams, you will oversee creative execution, video content, community engagement, and performance optimization. You will also leverage AI-powered tools to streamline workflows, enhance creativity, and scale content production while maintaining brand integrity. This fully remote contract opportunity is ideal for a strategic, data-driven marketer who thrives in fast-moving technology environments and understands the evolving social media landscape.

Accountabilities

Social Media Strategy and Channel Management: Develop and execute comprehensive social media strategies, primarily focused on X/Twitter, while managing and growing five or more brand accounts with consistent messaging and strategic alignment.
Growth and Performance Optimization: Establish KPIs and performance benchmarks, monitor audience growth, engagement, and conversions, and identify opportunities to improve channel performance through data-driven decisions.
Content Strategy and Creation: Translate brand positioning, technical developments, product launches, and marketing campaigns into engaging, platform-native content tailored to target audiences and community interests.
Creative and Video Production: Develop and direct high-quality content across multiple formats, including short-form videos, livestreams, and serialized content. Collaborate with designers, motion specialists, and other creative partners to deliver impactful social experiences.
Editorial Planning: Maintain a strategic editorial calendar that balances consistent daily publishing with major announcements, campaign launches, and timely industry developments.
AI-Powered Workflow Optimization: Use AI tools to accelerate content ideation, research, drafting, production, and publishing. Identify new technologies and implement efficient workflows without compromising quality, authenticity, or brand consistency.
Analytics and Reporting: Own organic social performance tracking, analyze trends and audience behavior, and present clear insights, results, and recommendations to senior leadership on a regular basis.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product, partnerships, design, events, and communications teams to coordinate messaging, align campaign execution, and maintain a cohesive brand narrative across channels.

Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about evolving social platforms, emerging formats, creator trends, and AI-powered marketing capabilities, translating relevant developments into actionable recommendations.

Requirements

Professional Experience: At least 8 years of experience in social media marketing and content marketing, with demonstrated ownership of both strategy and hands-on execution.

jobs.title: Lifecycle Growth Marketing Senior Manager - Onboarding
jobs.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About The Role

As the Lifecycle Growth Marketing Senior Manager - Onboarding, you will set the global strategy using data to turn new subscribers into active, engaged fans. You’ll design and scale personalized journeys that meet fans where they are—using recommendations, messaging, and contextual experiences to drive immersion, strengthen viewing habits, and build lasting connections with Crunchyroll. Operating at the intersection of Lifecycle Strategy, Analytics, Product, Engineering, User Acquisition, Go-To-Market, SVOD Strategy, Creative, Brand, and Marketing Operations, you will translate high-value actions, viewership, and behavioral patterns into customized experiences. You’ll pair quant-focused analysis with AI and LLM-enabled query workflows to evaluate performance, identify growth opportunities, and recommend precise, scalable optimizations.

In the role of Lifecycle Growth Marketing Senior Manager - Onboarding, you will report to the Director, Lifecycle Growth Marketing - Global VOD.

We are considering applicants for the location of Los Angeles, CA.

Core Areas of Responsibility

Set the Onboarding Agenda

Define and lead the end-to-end onboarding and early-tenure strategy, using retention from initial sign-up as a primary measure of success and a driver of long-term customer value.
Create a proactive, signal-based operating model that continuously advances the strategy through quantitative analysis, experimentation, fan insights, and business priorities.

Orchestrate Personalized Fan Journeys.

Design and scale personalized lifecycle journeys that adapt to each fan’s stage, interests, viewing activity, engagement level, and behavioral patterns.
Use recommendations, messaging, and contextual experiences to meet fans where they are, drive immersion, deepen content discovery, and strengthen repeat viewing and fandom habits.
Identify and prioritize high-value actions across fans and subscribers—including viewership and behavioral signals—and translate them into customized experiences that are relevant, timely, and designed to move measurable business outcomes.

Scale Personalization Through Braze & Orchestration

Own the strategic development of sophisticated journeys in Braze across push, email, SMS, in-app messages, Content Cards, WhatsApp, and MMS.
Establish operating standards for segmentation, personalization, real-time triggers, orchestration, testing, and quality assurance, partnering with Lifecycle Operations and Automations teams to scale execution with discipline.

Turn Data, AI & LLMs Into Growth Decisions

Define a rigorous, quant-focused measurement and optimization framework across retention, engagement, viewership, high-value actions, habituality, show diversity, and other business-critical outcomes.
Partner with Analytics and Data Science to use AI- and LLM-enabled analytics and query tools to explore journey and campaign performance, identify trends and opportunities, validate insights and incrementality, and translate learnings into scalable lifecycle optimization strategies that improve targeting and timing.

Lead End-to-End Growth Initiatives & OKR Delivery

Own growth initiatives end-to-end—from framing the business problem and opportunity, through strategy, execution, measurement, and iteration.
Identify and prioritize growth opportunities that increase the speed, quality, and effectiveness of lifecycle execution, helping the organization meet and exceed OKRs.
Bring a decisive bias for action to ambiguous, cross-functional challenges while maintaining rigor in prioritization, analysis, decision-making, and delivery.

Align Global Strategy Across the Organization

Lead alignment across Product, Engineering, User Acquisition, Go-To-Market, SVOD Strategy, Creative, Brand, Analytics, Marketing Operations, Content & Programming, and regional teams to deliver a unified subscriber experience.
Shape global and regional strategies with stakeholders across markets, improving performance through culturally relevant messaging, recommendations, and journey customization.
Represent lifecycle strategy in matrixed initiatives, connecting customer behavior, business priorities, and execution across the organization with clarity and influence.

Build Capability Through Team & Agency Leadership

Develop and lead a high-performing early-tenure lifecycle team, creating clarity of ownership, high standards, and a culture of continuous improvement.
Direct external agency partners supporting design, copy, operations, and QA workflows, with clear expectations for creative quality, operational rigor, and efficiency.

About You

We get excited about candidates, like you, because...

8+ years of progressive experience in Lifecycle Marketing, Retention Marketing, Growth Marketing, or a related discipline, with deep exposure to onboarding and early-tenure engagement strategies.
5+ years leading and developing globally distributed teams.
Demonstrated record of using data, experimentation, and customer behavior to improve retention, engagement, viewership, and personalized experiences.
Deep expertise with Braze or comparable orchestration platforms, including journey design, real-time triggers, segmentation, personalization, and multi-channel execution.
Highly quantitative and analytical, with the ability to turn behavioral, cohort, viewership, and lifecycle data into strategic direction and rigorous decisions.
Experience applying AI and LLMs to query performance data, accelerate analysis, surface insights, and deliver actionable optimization recommendations.
Proven ability to lead complex, end-to-end initiatives; identify business growth opportunities; and deliver against ambitious OKRs in a matrixed organization.
Executive-level communicator and critical thinker who creates clarity, influences stakeholders, and moves teams from insight to action.
High-ownership operator with a strong bias for action, sound judgment, and the operating discipline to prioritize effectively, execute with urgency, and learn quickly.
Experience overseeing multiple global lifecycle programs and external agencies with a focus on creative and operational excellence.
A genuine interest in anime, entertainment, or fan-focused brands and an ability to build an authentic connection with our content and audience.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.

About The Team

The Lifecycle Marketing team curates personalized journeys that engage, delight, and build long-term loyalty—from onboarding to retention and beyond. Through data-driven insights, we create strategies that connect users to the right experience, at the right time, on the right platform. Whether for our core streaming service or flywheel businesses, our mission is to promote growth, foster a membership mindset, and maximize lifetime value.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.
Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.
Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance
Health Saving Account HSA program

401(k) plan, with employer match

Other rewards may include performance bonuses, employer matched retirement savings, time-off programs, and progressive health benefits and perks.

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value

The Special Events & Marketing Manager leads the planning and execution of fundraising events that bring people together, inspire generosity, and deepen connection to Loaves & Fishes’ mission. This role combines creativity, relationship building, and hands-on project management with strong attention to detail to deliver a welcoming, high-quality guest experience from the first invitation through post-event follow-up. Working closely with Advancement colleagues, vendors, and volunteers, the Manager oversees event logistics, budgets, timelines and details, and helps achieve event revenue goals through sponsorship solicitation, auction procurement, and guest development. This position also supports the Marketing & Communications Team through event marketing, social media content, storytelling, and helping build a library of photos that capture our mission in action and support communications across the organization. The Special Events & Marketing Manager reports directly to the Sr. Director of Donor & Corporate Engagement with additional direction from the Director of Marketing & Communications.
